  function onPageUpdate() {
    if (!moduleActive) return;
    evaluate();
    document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-tab-gear")?.remove();
    const hiddenNativeBox = document.querySelector('div[class*="notInvolvedMembers"][data-sakalux-oco-hidden="1"]');
    if (hiddenNativeBox && !document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-intel-panel")) {
      hiddenNativeBox.style.removeProperty("display");
      delete hiddenNativeBox.dataset.sakaluxOcoHidden;
    }
    if (isCrimesTab()) {
      ensureScanButton();
      refreshNotInOCFromPage();
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();

      const visibleStage =
        getCrimesStageLabel();

      if (
        visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
        visibleStage === "Planning"
      ) {
        handleOcStageEntry(
          visibleStage
        ).catch(err => {
          log(
            "Automatic OC stage-entry scan failed:",
            err
          );
        });
      }
      const intelCardsReady = getNotInvolvedCards().length > 0;
      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && intelCardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = true;
        refreshOcIntelligence(true).catch(err => {
          onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = false;
          log("OC Intelligence refresh failed:", err);
        });
      } else if (!intelCardsReady) {
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      }
    }
    if (!isCrimesTab()) {
      lastObservedOcStage = "";
    }

    if (isUtilitiesTab()) {
      clearTimeout(onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer);
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
      ensureLegend();
      applyUtilitiesFlags();
      onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();
      }, 60);
    } else {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
  }

  function flashScanStatus(el, text, type, holdMs = 1600) {
    if (!el) return;
    clearTimeout(el._sakaluxTimer);
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    if (type === "success") {
      renderScanStatus(el);
      el.classList.add("is-success");
    } else if (type === "error") {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
      el.classList.add("is-error");
    } else {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
    }
    el._sakaluxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      renderScanStatus(el);
    }, holdMs);
  }

  function ensureScanButton() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    if (!bar) return;
    if (bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-btn-wrap")) {
      const statusEl = bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
      if (statusEl && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-success") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-error") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-scanning")) {
        renderScanStatus(statusEl);
      }
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();
      return;
    }
    const cs = getComputedStyle(bar);
    if (cs.display !== "flex") {
      bar.style.display = "flex";
      bar.style.alignItems = "center";
    }
    if (!bar.style.gap) bar.style.gap = "6px";
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "sakalux-oco-btn-wrap";
    wrap.innerHTML = `
      <button
        id="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        class="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        type="button"
        title="Scan this OC stage - scan both Recruiting and Planning for full results."
        aria-label="Scan OC stage"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M10.5 4a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 4.06 11.58l3.43 3.43 1.41-1.41-3.43-3.43A6.5 6.5 0 0 0 10.5 4Zm0 2a4.5 4.5 0 1 1 0 9 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 0-9Z"/>
        </svg>
        <span>Scan</span>
      </button>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-status" title="${sessionScanTooltip()}">${sessionScanStatusHTML()}</span>
    `;
    bar.appendChild(wrap);
    const btn = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-btn");
    const statusEl = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
    btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      btn.disabled = true;
      statusEl.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error");
      statusEl.classList.add("is-scanning");
      statusEl.textContent = "Scanning…";
      statusEl.title = "Scanning current OC stage…";
      try {
        const manualStage =
          getCrimesStageLabel();

        if (
          manualStage === "Recruiting" ||
          manualStage === "Planning"
        ) {
          markStageScanRequired(
            manualStage
          );
          updateStageVisuals();
        }

        let result =
          await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
            manualStage,
            true
          );

        if (!result?.ok) {
          result =
            await scanCurrentCrimesStage();
        }

        if (!result.ok) {
          flashScanStatus(
            statusEl,
            result.reason || "Go to Recruiting/Planning",
            "error",
            2200
          );
        } else {
          const visibleStage =
            getCrimesStageLabel();

          if (
            visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
            visibleStage === "Planning"
          ) {
            markStageScanComplete(
              visibleStage
            );
          }

          updateStageVisuals();
          pulseScanBtn(btn);
          itemTick();
          flashScanStatus(statusEl, sessionScanSummary(), "success");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[SakaLuX OC Role Match + Readiness] Scan error:", err);
        const detail = err?.message ? `Scan failed: ${err.message}` : "Scan failed: unexpected OC page error";
        flashScanStatus(statusEl, detail, "error", 4200);
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    });
    log("Scan button injected.");
    updateStageVisuals();
    bindStageAutoRescan();
  }
  function startIntelReadyPoll() {
    if (!moduleActive || intelReadyPoll) return;
    intelReadyPollStartedAt = Date.now();
    intelReadyPoll = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isCrimesTab()) {
        clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
        intelReadyPoll = null;
        return;
      }
      const cardsReady = getNotInvolvedCards().length > 0;
      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && cardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate();
      }
      if (
        onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage ||
        (Date.now() - intelReadyPollStartedAt) > 30000
      ) {
        clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
        intelReadyPoll = null;
      }
    }, 500);
  }

  function itemUsageLines(itemId) {
    const uses = OC_ITEM_USAGE[String(itemId)] || [];
    if (!uses.length) return [];
    const seen = new Set();
    return uses
      .map(u => {
        const note = u.note ? ` (${u.note})` : "";
        return `${u.oc} - ${u.role}${note}`;
      })
      .filter(line => {
        if (seen.has(line)) return false;
        seen.add(line);
        return true;
      });
  }
  function buildItemUsageTitle(itemId, lead) {
    const itemName = OC_ITEM_NAMES[String(itemId)] || `Item #${itemId}`;
    const lines = itemUsageLines(itemId);
    const parts = [];
    if (lead) parts.push(lead);
    if (lines.length) {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is used in:\n${lines.map(line => `• ${line}`).join("\n")}`);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is included as an OC utility item, but no OC role usage has been mapped yet.`);
    }
    return parts.join("\n\n");
  }

  const STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY = "sakalux_oco_stage_scan_state_v1";

  function readStageScanState() {
    const saved = store.get(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      {}
    );

    return {
      Recruiting: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Recruiting?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Recruiting?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      },
      Planning: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Planning?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Planning?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      }
    };
  }

  function writeStageScanState(stateValue) {
    store.set(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      stateValue
    );
  }

  const sessionScanState = {
    Recruiting: false,
    Planning: false
  };

  function markStageScanRequired(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = false;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      ...state[stage],
      completed: false
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function markStageScanComplete(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = true;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      completed: true,
      scannedAt: now()
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function isAllowedItemId(id) {
    const s = String(id ?? "");
    return s && !EXCLUDED_ITEM_IDS.has(s) && INCLUDED_ITEM_IDS.has(s);
  }
  function itemUsageLines(itemId) {
    const uses = OC_ITEM_USAGE[String(itemId)] || [];
    if (!uses.length) return [];
    const seen = new Set();
    return uses
      .map(u => {
        const note = u.note ? ` (${u.note})` : "";
        return `${u.oc} - ${u.role}${note}`;
      })
      .filter(line => {
        if (seen.has(line)) return false;
        seen.add(line);
        return true;
      });
  }
  function buildItemUsageTitle(itemId, lead) {
    const itemName = OC_ITEM_NAMES[String(itemId)] || `Item #${itemId}`;
    const lines = itemUsageLines(itemId);
    const parts = [];
    if (lead) parts.push(lead);
    if (lines.length) {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is used in:\n${lines.map(line => `• ${line}`).join("\n")}`);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is included as an OC utility item, but no OC role usage has been mapped yet.`);
    }
    return parts.join("\n\n");
  }

  function readStageScanState() {
    const saved = store.get(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      {}
    );

    return {
      Recruiting: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Recruiting?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Recruiting?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      },
      Planning: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Planning?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Planning?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      }
    };
  }

  function writeStageScanState(stateValue) {
    store.set(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      stateValue
    );
  }

  const sessionScanState = {
    Recruiting: false,
    Planning: false
  };

  function markStageScanRequired(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = false;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      ...state[stage],
      completed: false
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function markStageScanComplete(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = true;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      completed: true,
      scannedAt: now()
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function isAllowedItemId(id) {
    const s = String(id ?? "");
    return s && !EXCLUDED_ITEM_IDS.has(s) && INCLUDED_ITEM_IDS.has(s);

  function itemUsageLines(itemId) {
    const uses = OC_ITEM_USAGE[String(itemId)] || [];
    if (!uses.length) return [];
    const seen = new Set();
    return uses
      .map(u => {
        const note = u.note ? ` (${u.note})` : "";
        return `${u.oc} - ${u.role}${note}`;
      })
      .filter(line => {
        if (seen.has(line)) return false;
        seen.add(line);
        return true;
      });
  }
  function buildItemUsageTitle(itemId, lead) {
    const itemName = OC_ITEM_NAMES[String(itemId)] || `Item #${itemId}`;
    const lines = itemUsageLines(itemId);
    const parts = [];
    if (lead) parts.push(lead);
    if (lines.length) {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is used in:\n${lines.map(line => `• ${line}`).join("\n")}`);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is included as an OC utility item, but no OC role usage has been mapped yet.`);
    }
    return parts.join("\n\n");
  }

  function unwrapCrimeList(payload) {
    const candidates = [payload?.crimes, payload?.organized_crimes, payload?.organizedCrimes, payload?.data?.crimes, payload?.data?.organized_crimes, payload?.data];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
      if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        const arr = Object.values(value).filter(v => v && typeof v === "object");
        if (arr.length) return arr;
      }
    }
    return [];
  }
  async function tornApiFetch(path, apiKey) {
    const response = await fetch(`https://api.torn.com/v2${path}`, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: { "Authorization": `ApiKey ${apiKey}`, "Accept": "application/json" },
      credentials: "omit",
      cache: "no-store"
    });
    let data;
    try { data = await response.json(); }
    catch { throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`); }
    const apiError = data?.error || data?.errors?.[0];
    if (!response.ok || apiError) throw new Error(String(apiError?.error || apiError?.message || data?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`));
    return data;
  }
  async function fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force = false, pageCount = 4) {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error("API key not configured");
    const cached = loadLS(OC_API_CACHE_KEY);
    if (!force && cached?.ts && (now() - cached.ts) < OC_API_CACHE_MS && Array.isArray(cached.crimes)) {
      return cached.crimes;
    }
    const all = [];
    let offset = 0;
    const cutoff = Math.floor(now() / 1000) - OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_SECONDS;
    for (let page = 0; page < pageCount; page++) {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        cat: "completed",
        limit: String(OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT),
        offset: String(offset),
        sort: "DESC"
      });
      const payload = await tornApiFetch(`/faction/crimes?${query}`, apiKey);
      const crimes = unwrapCrimeList(payload);
      all.push(...crimes.filter(crime => {
        const completedAt = crimeCompletedAt(crime);
        return !completedAt || completedAt >= cutoff;
      }));
      const oldestCompleted = crimes
        .map(crimeCompletedAt)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) => a - b)[0] || 0;
      if (crimes.length < OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT || (oldestCompleted && oldestCompleted < cutoff)) break;
      offset += OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT;
    }
    saveLS(OC_API_CACHE_KEY, { ts: now(), crimes: all, cutoff });
    return all;
  }

  function apiSlotUserId(slot) {

  }

  function apiSlotRoleName(slot) {

      slot?.position?.name,

  function apiCrimeName(crime) {
    const candidates = [
      crime?.name,
      crime?.crime?.name,
      crime?.title
    ];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (typeof value !== "string") continue;

  function apiSlotRequirement(slot) {
    const req =
      slot?.item_requirement ||
      slot?.itemRequirement ||
      slot?.required_item ||
      slot?.requiredItem ||
      null;

    if (!req || typeof req !== "object") {
      return null;
    }

    const id =
      req.id ??
      req.item_id ??
      req.itemId ??
      null;

    if (!isAllowedItemId(id)) {
      return null;
    }

    const availabilityValues = [
      req.is_available,
      req.available,
      req.has_item,
      req.hasItem
    ].filter(value => typeof value === "boolean");

    const isAvailable =
      availabilityValues.length
        ? availabilityValues[0]
        : null;

    return {
      id: String(id),
      isAvailable
    };
  }

  function apiCrimeStage(crime) {
    const status = crimeStatus(crime);
    if (status.includes("recruit")) return "Recruiting";
    if (status.includes("plan")) return "Planning";
    return "";
  }

  function apiSlotUserId(slot) {
    const candidates = [
      slot?.user?.id,
      slot?.user?.user_id,
      slot?.user_id,
      slot?.userid,
      slot?.member?.id,
      slot?.member?.user_id,
      slot?.player?.id
    ];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (/^\d+$/.test(String(value ?? ""))) {
        return String(value);
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function apiSlotRoleName(slot) {
    const candidates = [
      slot?.position?.name,
      slot?.position,
      slot?.role?.name,
      slot?.role,
      slot?.role_name,
      slot?.roleName,
      slot?.name
    ];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (typeof value !== "string") continue;
      const clean = value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      if (clean && clean.length <= 80) return clean;
    }
    return "";
  }

  function apiCrimeName(crime) {
    const candidates = [
      crime?.name,
      crime?.crime?.name,
      crime?.title
    ];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (typeof value !== "string") continue;
      const clean = value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      if (clean && clean.length <= 100) return clean;
    }
    return "";
  }

  function apiSlotRequirement(slot) {
    const req =
      slot?.item_requirement ||
      slot?.itemRequirement ||
      slot?.required_item ||
      slot?.requiredItem ||
      null;

    if (!req || typeof req !== "object") {
      return null;
    }

    const id =
      req.id ??
      req.item_id ??
      req.itemId ??
      null;

    if (!isAllowedItemId(id)) {
      return null;
    }

    const availabilityValues = [
      req.is_available,
      req.available,
      req.has_item,
      req.hasItem
    ].filter(value => typeof value === "boolean");

    const isAvailable =
      availabilityValues.length
        ? availabilityValues[0]
        : null;

    return {
      id: String(id),
      isAvailable
    };
  }

  function apiCrimeSlots(crime) {
    const candidates = [
      crime?.slots,
      crime?.participants,
      crime?.members,
      crime?.crime?.slots
    ];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
      if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        const arr = Object.values(value).filter(
          slot => slot && typeof slot === "object"
        );
        if (arr.length) return arr;
      }
    }
    return [];
  }

  async function scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
    targetStage = getCrimesStageLabel(),
    force = false
  ) {
    if (
      targetStage !== "Recruiting" &&
      targetStage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage: targetStage,
        reason: "Not on Recruiting/Planning"
      };
    }

    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage: targetStage,
        reason: "API key not configured"
      };
    }

    if (
      !force &&
      apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage] &&
      (now() - apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage]) <
        API_OC_AUTO_SCAN_MS
    ) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        cached: true,
        stage: targetStage
      };
    }

    if (apiOcStagePromises[targetStage]) {
      return apiOcStagePromises[targetStage];
    }

    apiOcStagePromises[targetStage] = (async () => {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        cat: "available",
        limit: "100",
        sort: "ASC"
      });

      const payload =
        await tornApiFetch(
          `/faction/crimes?${query}`,
          apiKey
        );

      const crimes = unwrapCrimeList(payload);
      const byStage = {
        Recruiting: {
          usersInOC: new Set(),
          reqByUser: {},
          missingByUser: {},
          roleByUser: {},
          crimeByUser: {}
        },
        Planning: {
          usersInOC: new Set(),
          reqByUser: {},
          missingByUser: {},
          roleByUser: {},
          crimeByUser: {}
        }
      };

      for (const crime of crimes) {
        const stage = apiCrimeStage(crime);
        if (!stage || !byStage[stage]) continue;

        for (const slot of apiCrimeSlots(crime)) {
          const xid = apiSlotUserId(slot);
          if (!xid) continue;

          const stageData = byStage[stage];
          stageData.usersInOC.add(xid);

          const roleName =
            apiSlotRoleName(slot);
          const crimeName =
            apiCrimeName(crime);

          if (roleName) {
            stageData.roleByUser[xid] =
              roleName;
          }
          if (crimeName) {
            stageData.crimeByUser[xid] =
              crimeName;
          }

          const requirement =
            apiSlotRequirement(slot);

          if (!requirement) continue;

          if (!stageData.reqByUser[xid]) {
            stageData.reqByUser[xid] = [];
          }
          if (
            !stageData.reqByUser[xid].includes(
              requirement.id
            )
          ) {
            stageData.reqByUser[xid].push(
              requirement.id
            );
          }

          if (requirement.isAvailable === false) {
            if (!stageData.missingByUser[xid]) {
              stageData.missingByUser[xid] = [];
            }
            if (
              !stageData.missingByUser[xid].includes(
                requirement.id
              )
            ) {
              stageData.missingByUser[xid].push(
                requirement.id
              );
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const data =
        byStage[targetStage];

      writeScan({
        stage: targetStage,
        ts: now(),
        source: "api",
        usersInOC: [...data.usersInOC],
        reqByUser: data.reqByUser,
        missingByUser: data.missingByUser,
        roleByUser: data.roleByUser,
        crimeByUser: data.crimeByUser
      });

      apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage] = now();

      log("API OC scan saved:", {
        crimes: crimes.length,
        targetStage,
        recruiting: byStage.Recruiting.usersInOC.size,
        planning: byStage.Planning.usersInOC.size
      });

      return {
        ok: true,
        source: "api",
        stage: targetStage,
        crimes: crimes.length
      };
    })()
      .catch(error => {
        log("API OC auto scan failed:", error);
        return {
          ok: false,
          reason: error?.message || "API scan failed"
        };
      })
      .finally(() => {
        apiOcStagePromises[targetStage] =
          null;
      });

    return apiOcStagePromises[targetStage];
  }

  function calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes) {
    const memberTiers = {};
    const lastCompleted = {};
    const joinedCounts = {};
    const passedCounts = {};
    const cutoff = Math.floor(now() / 1000) - OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_SECONDS;
    for (const crime of crimes || []) {
      const completedAt = crimeCompletedAt(crime);
      if (completedAt && completedAt < cutoff) continue;
      const tier = crimeTier(crime);
      const status = crimeStatus(crime);
      const passed = !status || /(success|successful|completed|complete|executed|passed)/i.test(status);
      const members = crimeMemberIds(crime);
      for (const xid of members) {
        joinedCounts[xid] = (joinedCounts[xid] || 0) + 1;
        if (passed) {
          passedCounts[xid] = (passedCounts[xid] || 0) + 1;
          if (tier) {
            if (!memberTiers[xid]) memberTiers[xid] = [];
            memberTiers[xid].push(tier);
          }
          if (completedAt) {
            lastCompleted[xid] = Math.max(lastCompleted[xid] || 0, completedAt);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allIds = new Set([
      ...Object.keys(joinedCounts),
      ...Object.keys(passedCounts),
      ...Object.keys(memberTiers)
    ]);
    const intel = {};
    for (const xid of allIds) {
      const tiers = memberTiers[xid] || [];
      const counts = new Map();
      tiers.forEach(tier => counts.set(tier, (counts.get(tier) || 0) + 1));
      const average = tiers.length
        ? Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Math.round(tiers.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / tiers.length)))
        : 0;
      const preferredEntry = [...counts.entries()]
        .sort((a, b) => (b[1] - a[1]) || (b[0] - a[0]))[0] || [0, 0];
      intel[xid] = {
        average,
        preferred: preferredEntry[0] || 0,
        preferredCount: preferredEntry[1] || 0,
        highest: tiers.length ? Math.max(...tiers) : 0,
        joined: joinedCounts[xid] || 0,
        passed: passedCounts[xid] || 0,
        count: tiers.length,
        lastCompletedAt: lastCompleted[xid] || 0
      };
    }
    saveLS(OC_INTEL_KEY, {
      ts: now(),
      windowDays: OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_DAYS,
      members: intel
    });
    return intel;
  }

        joinedCounts[xid] = (joinedCounts[xid] || 0) + 1;
        if (passed) {
          passedCounts[xid] = (passedCounts[xid] || 0) + 1;
          if (tier) {
            if (!memberTiers[xid]) memberTiers[xid] = [];
            memberTiers[xid].push(tier);
          }
          if (completedAt) {
            lastCompleted[xid] = Math.max(lastCompleted[xid] || 0, completedAt);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const allIds = new Set([
      ...Object.keys(joinedCounts),
      ...Object.keys(passedCounts),
      ...Object.keys(memberTiers)
    ]);
    const intel = {};
    for (const xid of allIds) {
      const tiers = memberTiers[xid] || [];
      const counts = new Map();
      tiers.forEach(tier => counts.set(tier, (counts.get(tier) || 0) + 1));
      const average = tiers.length
        ? Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Math.round(tiers.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / tiers.length)))
        : 0;
      const preferredEntry = [...counts.entries()]
        .sort((a, b) => (b[1] - a[1]) || (b[0] - a[0]))[0] || [0, 0];
      intel[xid] = {
        average,
        preferred: preferredEntry[0] || 0,
        preferredCount: preferredEntry[1] || 0,
        highest: tiers.length ? Math.max(...tiers) : 0,
        joined: joinedCounts[xid] || 0,
        passed: passedCounts[xid] || 0,
        count: tiers.length,
        lastCompletedAt: lastCompleted[xid] || 0
      };
    }
    saveLS(OC_INTEL_KEY, {
      ts: now(),
      windowDays: OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_DAYS,
      members: intel
    });
    return intel;
  }
  function formatOutsideDuration(seconds) {
    const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(seconds) || 0));
    const days = Math.floor(total / 86400);
    const hours = Math.floor((total % 86400) / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
    if (days > 0) return `${days}d ${hours}h`;
    if (hours > 0) return `${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
    return `${Math.max(1, minutes)}m`;
  }
  function outsideClass(seconds) {
    if (seconds >= 3 * 86400) return "red";
    if (seconds >= 1 * 86400) return "orange";
    return "good";
  }
  function getNotInvolvedBox() { return document.querySelector('div[class*="notInvolvedMembers"]'); }
  function getNotInvolvedCards() {
    const box = getNotInvolvedBox();
    if (!box) return [];

    const profileLinks = Array.from(
      box.querySelectorAll('a[href*="profiles.php?XID="]')
    );

    const seen = new Set();
    const cards = [];

    for (const link of profileLinks) {
      const xid = xidFromHref(link.getAttribute("href"));
      if (!xid || seen.has(String(xid))) continue;
      seen.add(String(xid));

      const row =
        link.closest('li[class*="item"]') ||
        link.closest("li") ||
        link.closest('[class*="member"]') ||
        link.closest('[class*="item"]') ||
        link.parentElement ||
        box;

      const honorImg =
        row.querySelector?.('img[alt]') ||
        link.querySelector?.('img[alt]');

      const plainHonor = Array.from(
        row.querySelectorAll?.("span.honor-text") || []
      )
        .map(el => (el.textContent || "").trim())
        .find(Boolean);

      const symbolName = Array.from(
        row.querySelectorAll?.('[class*="honorTextSymbol"]') || []
      )
        .map(el => el.dataset.char || "")
        .join("")
        .trim();

      const ariaName = String(
        link.getAttribute("aria-label") || ""
      )
        .replace(/^View profile of\s+/i, "")
        .trim();

      const linkText = String(link.textContent || "")
        .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
        .trim();

      const name =
        honorImg?.getAttribute("alt")?.trim() ||
        plainHonor ||
        symbolName ||
        ariaName ||
        linkText ||
        `Member #${xid}`;

      cards.push({ li: row, link, xid: String(xid), name });
    }

    return cards;
  }

  async function refreshOcIntelligence(force = false) {
    if (!isCrimesTab() || !getNotInvolvedBox()) return;
    renderOcIntelligence(null, true);
    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) { renderOcIntelligence(null, false, "Add a Torn API key in Master Settings."); return; }
    if (ocIntelPromise && !force) return ocIntelPromise;
    ocIntelPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const crimes = await fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force);
        const intel = calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes);
        renderOcIntelligence(intel);
      } catch (err) {
        renderOcIntelligence(null, false, `OC Intelligence error: ${err.message || err}`);
        throw err;
      } finally { ocIntelPromise = null; }
    })();
    return ocIntelPromise;
  }

  async function refreshOcIntelligence(force = false) {
    if (!isCrimesTab() || !getNotInvolvedBox()) return;
    renderOcIntelligence(null, true);
    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) { renderOcIntelligence(null, false, "Add a Torn API key in Master Settings."); return; }
    if (ocIntelPromise && !force) return ocIntelPromise;
    ocIntelPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const crimes = await fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force);
        const intel = calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes);
        renderOcIntelligence(intel);
      } catch (err) {
        renderOcIntelligence(null, false, `OC Intelligence error: ${err.message || err}`);
        throw err;
      } finally { ocIntelPromise = null; }
    })();
    return ocIntelPromise;
  }

  let ocIntelPromise = null;
  async function refreshOcIntelligence(force = false) {
    if (!isCrimesTab() || !getNotInvolvedBox()) return;
    renderOcIntelligence(null, true);
    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) { renderOcIntelligence(null, false, "Add a Torn API key in Master Settings."); return; }
    if (ocIntelPromise && !force) return ocIntelPromise;
    ocIntelPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const crimes = await fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force);
        const intel = calculateMemberIntelligence(crimes);
        renderOcIntelligence(intel);
      } catch (err) {
        renderOcIntelligence(null, false, `OC Intelligence error: ${err.message || err}`);
        throw err;
      } finally { ocIntelPromise = null; }
    })();
    return ocIntelPromise;
  }
  function sessionScanSummary() {
    return `Recruiting ${sessionScanState.Recruiting ? "✓" : "·"} | Planning ${sessionScanState.Planning ? "✓" : "·"}`;
  }
  function sessionScanStatusHTML() {
    const recDone = !!sessionScanState.Recruiting;
    const planDone = !!sessionScanState.Planning;
    return `
        <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-line ${recDone ? "is-done" : "is-pending"}">
          <span>Recruiting</span><b>${recDone ? "✓" : "·"}</b>
        </span>
        <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-line ${planDone ? "is-done" : "is-pending"}">
          <span>Planning</span><b>${planDone ? "✓" : "·"}</b>
        </span>`;
  }
  function sessionScanTooltip() {
    return [
      sessionScanState.Recruiting ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete" : "Recruiting - Scan Required",
      sessionScanState.Planning ? "Planning - Scan Complete" : "Planning - Scan Required"
    ].join(" • ");
  }

  async function openMenuAndGetXid(slotRoot) {
    const btn = findActionButtons().find(b => slotRoot.contains(b));
    if (!btn) return null;
    const before = new Set(collectMenuProfileLinks());
    const btnCenter = rectCenter(btn);
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(btn, "mousedown");
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(btn, "mouseup");
    btn.click();
    await sleep(Math.max(MENU_OPEN_MS,420));
    const allLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="profiles.php?XID="]'));
    const isMenuLink = a => /view profile/i.test(a.textContent) || a.closest('div[class*="slotMenu"]');
    let candidates = allLinks.filter(a => {
      const href = a.getAttribute("href");
      return href && !before.has(href) && isMenuLink(a);
    });
    if (!candidates.length) candidates = allLinks.filter(isMenuLink);
    const best = candidates.sort((a, b) => dist(rectCenter(a), btnCenter) - dist(rectCenter(b), btnCenter))[0];
    const xid = xidFromHref(best?.getAttribute("href"));
    if(btn.isConnected){
      btn.click();
      await sleep(MENU_CLOSE_MS);
    }
    return xid ?? null;
  }
  function getAllTooltips() {
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="tooltip"], div[class*="tooltip"]'));
  }
  async function hoverAndGetTooltip(host) {
    if (!host) return null;
    const before = new Set(getAllTooltips().map(t => t.id).filter(Boolean));
    const hostCenter = rectCenter(host);
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseenter");
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseover");
    await sleep(TOOLTIP_OPEN_DELAY);
    const tipId = host.getAttribute("aria-describedby");
    let tip = tipId ? document.getElementById(tipId) : null;
    if (!tip) {
      const all = getAllTooltips();
      const candidates = all.filter(t => !t.id || !before.has(t.id));
      const pool = candidates.length ? candidates : all;
      if (pool.length) {
        tip = pool.sort((a, b) => dist(rectCenter(a), hostCenter) - dist(rectCenter(b), hostCenter))[0];
      }
    }
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseleave");
    dispatchSafeMouseEvent(host, "mouseout");
    await sleep(TOOLTIP_CLOSE_DELAY);
    return tip ?? null;
  }
  function extractItemIdFromTooltip(tip) {
    if (!tip) return null;
    const text = (tip.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    const html = tip.innerHTML || "";
    const aria = tip.querySelector("[aria-label]")?.getAttribute("aria-label") || "";
    const check = s => /used item\s*:|required item\s*:/i.test(s);
    if (!check(text) && !check(html) && !check(aria)) return null;
    const img = tip.querySelector('img[src*="/images/items/"]');
    return itemIdFromSrc(img?.getAttribute("src")) ?? (html + text).match(/\/images\/items\/(\d+)\//i)?.[1] ?? null;
  }
  function getCrimesStageLabel() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons } = getStageButtons();
    const btns = stageButtons?.length ? stageButtons : [recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn].filter(Boolean);
    const active = btns.find(isActiveStageButton) || btns.find(b => {
      const aria = String(b.getAttribute("aria-selected") || b.getAttribute("aria-current") || "").toLowerCase();
      return aria === "true" || aria === "page";
    });
    const txt = (active?.textContent || "").trim();
    if (/recruit/i.test(txt)) return "Recruiting";
    if (/plan/i.test(txt)) return "Planning";
    if (/compl/i.test(txt)) return "Completed";
    return txt || "Unknown";
  }
  function directSlotXid(slotRoot) {
    if(!slotRoot)return null;
    const link = slotRoot.querySelector(
      'a[href*="profiles.php?XID="],a[href*="/profiles.php?XID="]'
    );
    const fromLink=xidFromHref(link?.getAttribute("href"));
    if(fromLink)return fromLink;
    const dataElement=slotRoot.querySelector(
      "[data-user-id],[data-xid],[data-user]"
    );
    const dataValue=
      dataElement?.dataset?.userId ||
      dataElement?.dataset?.xid ||
      dataElement?.dataset?.user ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-user-id") ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-xid") ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-user");
    if(/^\d+$/.test(String(dataValue||""))){
      return String(dataValue);
    }
    const html=slotRoot.innerHTML||"";
    const match=html.match(
      /(?:XID=|data-(?:user-id|xid)=["']?)(\d+)/i
    );
    return match?.[1]||null;
  }
  function directSlotItemId(slotRoot) {
    if (!slotRoot) return null;
    const images = Array.from(
      slotRoot.querySelectorAll('img[src*="/images/items/"]')
    );
    for (const image of images) {
      const id = itemIdFromSrc(image.getAttribute("src"));
      if (isAllowedItemId(id)) return String(id);
    }
    const dataItem = slotRoot.querySelector(
      "[data-itemid],[data-item-id]"
    );
    const dataId =
      dataItem?.dataset?.itemid ||
      dataItem?.dataset?.itemId ||
      dataItem?.getAttribute("data-itemid") ||
      dataItem?.getAttribute("data-item-id");
    return isAllowedItemId(dataId) ? String(dataId) : null;
  }
  async function scanCurrentCrimesStage() {
    const stage = getCrimesStageLabel();
    refreshNotInOCFromPage();
    if (stage !== "Recruiting" && stage !== "Planning") {
      return { ok: false, stage, reason: "Open Recruiting or Planning first" };
    }

    // Torn often paints the stage tabs before the OC role cards are actually mounted.
    // Give the live DOM a short window to finish rendering instead of failing instantly.
    let roots = findSlotRoots();
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 8 && !roots.length; attempt += 1) {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
      roots = findSlotRoots();
    }

    if (!roots.length) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage,
        reason: `${stage} loaded, but no OC role slots are visible yet`
      };
    }

    const usersInOC = new Set();
    const reqByUser = {};
    const roleByUser = {};
    const rootErrors = [];

    for (const root of roots) {
      try {
        let xid = directSlotXid(root);
        if (!xid) {
          try { xid = await openMenuAndGetXid(root); }
          catch (error) { rootErrors.push(`member: ${error?.message || error}`); }
        }
        if (!xid) continue;

        usersInOC.add(xid);
        if (!reqByUser[xid]) reqByUser[xid] = [];

        const roleName = (
          root.querySelector('[class*="title"], [class*="role"]')?.textContent || ""
        ).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        if (roleName) roleByUser[xid] = roleName;

        let itemId = directSlotItemId(root);
        if (!itemId) {
          try {
            const hoverHost =
              root.querySelector('button[class*="slotHeader"],[class*="slotHeader"]') ||
              root.querySelector('[aria-describedby]') ||
              root;
            const tip = await hoverAndGetTooltip(hoverHost);
            itemId = extractItemIdFromTooltip(tip);
          } catch (error) {
            // Required-item tooltip failure must not abort the entire stage scan.
            rootErrors.push(`item: ${error?.message || error}`);
          }
        }

        if (isAllowedItemId(itemId)) {
          const sid = String(itemId);
          if (!reqByUser[xid].includes(sid)) reqByUser[xid].push(sid);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        rootErrors.push(error?.message || String(error));
        log("OC slot scan skipped after error:", error);
      }
    }

    if (!usersInOC.size) {
      const suffix = rootErrors.length ? ` (${rootErrors[0]})` : "";
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage,
        reason: `Found ${roots.length} OC role slots but could not read members${suffix}`
      };
    }

    const scan = {
      stage,
      ts: now(),
      source: "dom",
      usersInOC: [...usersInOC],
      reqByUser,
      missingByUser: {},
      roleByUser
    };
    writeScan(scan);
    sessionScanState[stage] = true;
    log("Scan saved:", {
      stage,
      users: scan.usersInOC.length,
      roots: roots.length,
      skippedErrors: rootErrors.length
    });
    return { ok: true, stage, scan, skippedErrors: rootErrors.length };
  }

      );
    if (!header) return;

  function ensureLegend() {
    const header =
      document.querySelector("li.item-title") ||
      document.querySelector(
        '[class*="armoury"] [class*="title"], [class*="utilities"] [class*="title"]'
      );
    if (!header) return;

    header.classList.add(
      "sakalux-oco-legend-host"
    );

    if (header.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-legend")) return;

    const legend = document.createElement("span");
    legend.className = "sakalux-oco-legend";

  function extractItemIdFromTooltip(tip) {
    if (!tip) return null;
    const text = (tip.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    const html = tip.innerHTML || "";
    const aria = tip.querySelector("[aria-label]")?.getAttribute("aria-label") || "";
    const check = s => /used item\s*:|required item\s*:/i.test(s);
    if (!check(text) && !check(html) && !check(aria)) return null;
    const img = tip.querySelector('img[src*="/images/items/"]');
    return itemIdFromSrc(img?.getAttribute("src")) ?? (html + text).match(/\/images\/items\/(\d+)\//i)?.[1] ?? null;
  }
  function getCrimesStageLabel() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons } = getStageButtons();
    const btns = stageButtons?.length ? stageButtons : [recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn].filter(Boolean);
    const active = btns.find(isActiveStageButton) || btns.find(b => {
      const aria = String(b.getAttribute("aria-selected") || b.getAttribute("aria-current") || "").toLowerCase();
      return aria === "true" || aria === "page";
    });
    const txt = (active?.textContent || "").trim();
    if (/recruit/i.test(txt)) return "Recruiting";
    if (/plan/i.test(txt)) return "Planning";
    if (/compl/i.test(txt)) return "Completed";
    return txt || "Unknown";
  }
  function directSlotXid(slotRoot) {
    if(!slotRoot)return null;
    const link = slotRoot.querySelector(
      'a[href*="profiles.php?XID="],a[href*="/profiles.php?XID="]'
    );
    const fromLink=xidFromHref(link?.getAttribute("href"));
    if(fromLink)return fromLink;
    const dataElement=slotRoot.querySelector(
      "[data-user-id],[data-xid],[data-user]"
    );
    const dataValue=
      dataElement?.dataset?.userId ||
      dataElement?.dataset?.xid ||
      dataElement?.dataset?.user ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-user-id") ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-xid") ||
      dataElement?.getAttribute("data-user");
    if(/^\d+$/.test(String(dataValue||""))){
      return String(dataValue);
    }
    const html=slotRoot.innerHTML||"";
    const match=html.match(
      /(?:XID=|data-(?:user-id|xid)=["']?)(\d+)/i
    );
    return match?.[1]||null;
  }
  function directSlotItemId(slotRoot) {
    if (!slotRoot) return null;
    const images = Array.from(
      slotRoot.querySelectorAll('img[src*="/images/items/"]')
    );
    for (const image of images) {
      const id = itemIdFromSrc(image.getAttribute("src"));
      if (isAllowedItemId(id)) return String(id);
    }
    const dataItem = slotRoot.querySelector(
      "[data-itemid],[data-item-id]"
    );
    const dataId =
      dataItem?.dataset?.itemid ||
      dataItem?.dataset?.itemId ||
      dataItem?.getAttribute("data-itemid") ||
      dataItem?.getAttribute("data-item-id");
    return isAllowedItemId(dataId) ? String(dataId) : null;
  }
  async function scanCurrentCrimesStage() {
    const stage = getCrimesStageLabel();
    refreshNotInOCFromPage();
    if (stage !== "Recruiting" && stage !== "Planning") {
      return { ok: false, stage, reason: "Open Recruiting or Planning first" };
    }

    // Torn often paints the stage tabs before the OC role cards are actually mounted.
    // Give the live DOM a short window to finish rendering instead of failing instantly.
    let roots = findSlotRoots();
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 8 && !roots.length; attempt += 1) {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
      roots = findSlotRoots();
    }

    if (!roots.length) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage,
        reason: `${stage} loaded, but no OC role slots are visible yet`
      };
    }

    const usersInOC = new Set();
    const reqByUser = {};
    const roleByUser = {};
    const rootErrors = [];

    for (const root of roots) {
      try {
        let xid = directSlotXid(root);
        if (!xid) {
          try { xid = await openMenuAndGetXid(root); }
          catch (error) { rootErrors.push(`member: ${error?.message || error}`); }
        }
        if (!xid) continue;

        usersInOC.add(xid);
        if (!reqByUser[xid]) reqByUser[xid] = [];

        const roleName = (
          root.querySelector('[class*="title"], [class*="role"]')?.textContent || ""
        ).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        if (roleName) roleByUser[xid] = roleName;

        let itemId = directSlotItemId(root);
        if (!itemId) {
          try {
            const hoverHost =
              root.querySelector('button[class*="slotHeader"],[class*="slotHeader"]') ||
              root.querySelector('[aria-describedby]') ||
              root;
            const tip = await hoverAndGetTooltip(hoverHost);
            itemId = extractItemIdFromTooltip(tip);
          } catch (error) {
            // Required-item tooltip failure must not abort the entire stage scan.
            rootErrors.push(`item: ${error?.message || error}`);
          }
        }

        if (isAllowedItemId(itemId)) {
          const sid = String(itemId);
          if (!reqByUser[xid].includes(sid)) reqByUser[xid].push(sid);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        rootErrors.push(error?.message || String(error));
        log("OC slot scan skipped after error:", error);
      }
    }

    if (!usersInOC.size) {
      const suffix = rootErrors.length ? ` (${rootErrors[0]})` : "";
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage,
        reason: `Found ${roots.length} OC role slots but could not read members${suffix}`
      };
    }

    const scan = {
      stage,
      ts: now(),
      source: "dom",
      usersInOC: [...usersInOC],
      reqByUser,
      missingByUser: {},
      roleByUser
    };
    writeScan(scan);
    sessionScanState[stage] = true;
    log("Scan saved:", {
      stage,
      users: scan.usersInOC.length,
      roots: roots.length,
      skippedErrors: rootErrors.length
    });
    return { ok: true, stage, scan, skippedErrors: rootErrors.length };
  }
  function ensureLegend() {
    const header =
      document.querySelector("li.item-title") ||
      document.querySelector(
        '[class*="armoury"] [class*="title"], [class*="utilities"] [class*="title"]'
      );
    if (!header) return;

    header.classList.add(
      "sakalux-oco-legend-host"
    );

    if (header.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-legend")) return;

    const legend = document.createElement("span");
    legend.className = "sakalux-oco-legend";
    legend.title = "Green = Required • Yellow = Not Required • Red = Not in OC";
    legend.innerHTML = `
      <span class="sakalux-oco-legend-item"><span class="sakalux-oco-legend-dot green"></span>Required</span>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-legend-item"><span class="sakalux-oco-legend-dot yellow"></span>Not Required</span>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-legend-item"><span class="sakalux-oco-legend-dot red"></span>Not in OC</span>
    `;
    header.appendChild(legend);
  }

  function stageButtonText(btn) {
    return String(
      btn?.textContent ||
      btn?.getAttribute?.("aria-label") ||
      btn?.getAttribute?.("title") ||
      ""
    ).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase();

  function isStageButton(btn) {
    const t = stageButtonText(btn);
    return /\b(recruiting|recruit|planning|plan|completed|complete)\b/i.test(t);
  }
  function isActiveStageButton(btn) {
    if (!btn) return false;
    const cls = String(btn.className || "").toLowerCase();
    const ariaSelected = String(btn.getAttribute?.("aria-selected") || "").toLowerCase();
    const ariaCurrent = String(btn.getAttribute?.("aria-current") || "").toLowerCase();
    return cls.includes("active") || cls.includes("selected") || ariaSelected === "true" || ariaCurrent === "page";
  }
  function candidateStageButtons() {
    const selectors = [
      "div.buttonsContainer___aClaa button",
      "button",
      "[role='tab']",
      "[role='button']"
    ];
    return [...new Set(selectors.flatMap(sel => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(sel))))]
      .filter(el => el && isStageButton(el));
  }
  function commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons) {
    const arr = (buttons || []).filter(Boolean);
    if (!arr.length) return null;
    const counts = new Map();
    for (const btn of arr) {
      let el = btn.parentElement;
      for (let i = 0; i < 8 && el && el !== document.body; i++, el = el.parentElement) {
        counts.set(el, (counts.get(el) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    let best = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const [el, count] of counts.entries()) {
      if (count < 2) continue;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect?.();
      const score = (count * 1000) - ((r?.height || 0) + (r?.width || 0) / 100);
      if (score > bestScore) {
        best = el;
        bestScore = score;
      }
    }
    return best || arr[0].parentElement || null;
  }
  function getTabsBar() {
    const oldBar = document.querySelector("div.buttonsContainer___aClaa");
    if (oldBar && oldBar.querySelector("button")) return oldBar;
    const buttons = candidateStageButtons();
    return commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons);
  }
  function getStageButtons() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    const pool = bar
      ? Array.from(bar.querySelectorAll("button, [role='tab'], [role='button']")).filter(isStageButton)
      : candidateStageButtons();
    let recruitingBtn = null;
    let planningBtn = null;
    let completedBtn = null;
    for (const btn of pool) {
      const t = stageButtonText(btn);
      if (!recruitingBtn && /recruit/.test(t)) recruitingBtn = btn;
      if (!planningBtn && /plan/.test(t)) planningBtn = btn;
      if (!completedBtn && /complet/.test(t)) completedBtn = btn;
    }
    return { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons: pool };
  }
  async function handleOcStageEntry(
    stage = getCrimesStageLabel()
  ) {
    if (
      !moduleActive ||
      !isCrimesTab() ||
      (
        stage !== "Recruiting" &&
        stage !== "Planning"
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (stage === lastObservedOcStage) {
      return;
    }

    // Mark entry immediately so MutationObserver rerenders cannot
    // schedule duplicate API calls while this request is in flight.
    lastObservedOcStage = stage;

    markStageScanRequired(stage);
    updateStageVisuals();

    const statusEl =
      document.querySelector(
        ".sakalux-oco-scan-status"
      );

    if (statusEl) {
      statusEl.classList.remove(
        "is-success",
        "is-error"
      );
      statusEl.classList.add(
        "is-scanning"
      );
      statusEl.textContent =
        `Scanning ${stage} members and roles...`;
      statusEl.title =
        `Scanning every ${stage} OC member, role and required item...`;
    }

    const result =
      await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
        stage,
        true
      );

    if (
      result?.ok &&
      result?.stage === stage
    ) {
      markStageScanComplete(stage);
      updateStageVisuals();
      itemTick();
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";

      if (statusEl) {
        flashScanStatus(
          statusEl,
          sessionScanSummary(),
          "success"
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (statusEl) {
      flashScanStatus(
        statusEl,
        result?.reason ||
          "API refresh failed",
        "error",
        2200
      );
    }
  }

  function bindStageAutoRescan() {
    const {
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    } = getStageButtons();

    for (const button of [
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    ]) {
      if (
        !button ||
        button.dataset
          .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound === "1"
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      button.dataset
        .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound = "1";

      button.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            handleOcStageEntry(
              getCrimesStageLabel()
            ).catch(error => {
              log(
                "OC stage-entry scan failed:",
                error
              );
            });
          }, 120);
        }
      );
    }
  }

  function updateStageVisuals() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn } = getStageButtons();
    const persistentState =
      readStageScanState();

    sessionScanState.Recruiting =
      !!persistentState.Recruiting.completed;
    sessionScanState.Planning =
      !!persistentState.Planning.completed;

    if (
      sessionScanState.Recruiting &&
      sessionScanState.Planning
    ) {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
    if (recruitingBtn) {
      recruitingBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Recruiting);
      recruitingBtn.title = sessionScanState.Recruiting
        ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete"
        : "Recruiting - Scan Required";
    }
    if (planningBtn) {
      planningBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Planning);
      planningBtn.title = sessionScanState.Planning
        ? "Planning - Scan Complete"
        : "Planning - Scan Required";
    }
  }

      el.textContent = text;

      renderScanStatus(el);
    }, holdMs);
  }

  function getStageButtons() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    const pool = bar
      ? Array.from(bar.querySelectorAll("button, [role='tab'], [role='button']")).filter(isStageButton)
      : candidateStageButtons();
    let recruitingBtn = null;
    let planningBtn = null;
    let completedBtn = null;
    for (const btn of pool) {
      const t = stageButtonText(btn);
      if (!recruitingBtn && /recruit/.test(t)) recruitingBtn = btn;
      if (!planningBtn && /plan/.test(t)) planningBtn = btn;
      if (!completedBtn && /complet/.test(t)) completedBtn = btn;
    }
    return { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons: pool };
  }
  async function handleOcStageEntry(
    stage = getCrimesStageLabel()
  ) {
    if (
      !moduleActive ||
      !isCrimesTab() ||
      (
        stage !== "Recruiting" &&
        stage !== "Planning"
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (stage === lastObservedOcStage) {
      return;
    }

    // Mark entry immediately so MutationObserver rerenders cannot
    // schedule duplicate API calls while this request is in flight.
    lastObservedOcStage = stage;

    markStageScanRequired(stage);
    updateStageVisuals();

    const statusEl =
      document.querySelector(
        ".sakalux-oco-scan-status"
      );

    if (statusEl) {
      statusEl.classList.remove(
        "is-success",
        "is-error"
      );
      statusEl.classList.add(
        "is-scanning"
      );
      statusEl.textContent =
        `Scanning ${stage} members and roles...`;
      statusEl.title =
        `Scanning every ${stage} OC member, role and required item...`;
    }

    const result =
      await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
        stage,
        true
      );

    if (
      result?.ok &&
      result?.stage === stage
    ) {
      markStageScanComplete(stage);
      updateStageVisuals();
      itemTick();
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";

      if (statusEl) {
        flashScanStatus(
          statusEl,
          sessionScanSummary(),
          "success"
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (statusEl) {
      flashScanStatus(
        statusEl,
        result?.reason ||
          "API refresh failed",
        "error",
        2200
      );
    }
  }

  function bindStageAutoRescan() {
    const {
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    } = getStageButtons();

    for (const button of [
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    ]) {
      if (
        !button ||
        button.dataset
          .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound === "1"
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      button.dataset
        .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound = "1";

      button.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            handleOcStageEntry(
              getCrimesStageLabel()
            ).catch(error => {
              log(
                "OC stage-entry scan failed:",
                error
              );
            });
          }, 120);
        }
      );
    }
  }

  function updateStageVisuals() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn } = getStageButtons();
    const persistentState =
      readStageScanState();

    sessionScanState.Recruiting =
      !!persistentState.Recruiting.completed;
    sessionScanState.Planning =
      !!persistentState.Planning.completed;

    if (
      sessionScanState.Recruiting &&
      sessionScanState.Planning
    ) {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
    if (recruitingBtn) {
      recruitingBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Recruiting);
      recruitingBtn.title = sessionScanState.Recruiting
        ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete"
        : "Recruiting - Scan Required";
    }
    if (planningBtn) {
      planningBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Planning);
      planningBtn.title = sessionScanState.Planning
        ? "Planning - Scan Complete"
        : "Planning - Scan Required";
    }
  }
  function renderScanStatus(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    el.innerHTML = sessionScanStatusHTML();
    el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
  }
  function flashScanStatus(el, text, type, holdMs = 1600) {
    if (!el) return;
    clearTimeout(el._sakaluxTimer);
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    if (type === "success") {
      renderScanStatus(el);
      el.classList.add("is-success");
    } else if (type === "error") {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
      el.classList.add("is-error");
    } else {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
    }
    el._sakaluxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      renderScanStatus(el);
    }, holdMs);
  }
  function pulseScanBtn(btn) {
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.classList.remove("sakalux-oco-pulse");
    void btn.offsetWidth;
    btn.classList.add("sakalux-oco-pulse");
  }

    } else if (type === "error") {

      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();

      renderScanStatus(el);

  }
  function pulseScanBtn(btn) {
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.classList.remove("sakalux-oco-pulse");
    void btn.offsetWidth;
    btn.classList.add("sakalux-oco-pulse");
  }
  function ensureScanButton() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    if (!bar) return;
    if (bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-btn-wrap")) {
      const statusEl = bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
      if (statusEl && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-success") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-error") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-scanning")) {
        renderScanStatus(statusEl);
      }
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();
      return;
    }
    const cs = getComputedStyle(bar);
    if (cs.display !== "flex") {
      bar.style.display = "flex";
      bar.style.alignItems = "center";
    }
    if (!bar.style.gap) bar.style.gap = "6px";
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "sakalux-oco-btn-wrap";
    wrap.innerHTML = `
      <button
        id="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        class="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        type="button"
        title="Scan this OC stage - scan both Recruiting and Planning for full results."
        aria-label="Scan OC stage"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M10.5 4a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 4.06 11.58l3.43 3.43 1.41-1.41-3.43-3.43A6.5 6.5 0 0 0 10.5 4Zm0 2a4.5 4.5 0 1 1 0 9 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 0-9Z"/>
        </svg>
        <span>Scan</span>
      </button>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-status" title="${sessionScanTooltip()}">${sessionScanStatusHTML()}</span>
    `;
    bar.appendChild(wrap);
    const btn = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-btn");
    const statusEl = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
    btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      btn.disabled = true;
      statusEl.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error");
      statusEl.classList.add("is-scanning");
      statusEl.textContent = "Scanning…";
      statusEl.title = "Scanning current OC stage…";
      try {
        const manualStage =
          getCrimesStageLabel();

        if (
          manualStage === "Recruiting" ||
          manualStage === "Planning"
        ) {
          markStageScanRequired(
            manualStage
          );
          updateStageVisuals();
        }

        let result =
          await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
            manualStage,
            true
          );

        if (!result?.ok) {
          result =
            await scanCurrentCrimesStage();
        }

        if (!result.ok) {
          flashScanStatus(
            statusEl,
            result.reason || "Go to Recruiting/Planning",
            "error",
            2200
          );
        } else {
          const visibleStage =
            getCrimesStageLabel();

          if (
            visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
            visibleStage === "Planning"
          ) {
            markStageScanComplete(
              visibleStage
            );
          }

          updateStageVisuals();
          pulseScanBtn(btn);
          itemTick();
          flashScanStatus(statusEl, sessionScanSummary(), "success");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[SakaLuX OC Role Match + Readiness] Scan error:", err);
        const detail = err?.message ? `Scan failed: ${err.message}` : "Scan failed: unexpected OC page error";
        flashScanStatus(statusEl, detail, "error", 4200);
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    });
    log("Scan button injected.");
    updateStageVisuals();
    bindStageAutoRescan();
  }
  function startIntelReadyPoll() {
    if (!moduleActive || intelReadyPoll) return;
    intelReadyPollStartedAt = Date.now();
    intelReadyPoll = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isCrimesTab()) {
        clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
        intelReadyPoll = null;
        return;
      }
      const cardsReady = getNotInvolvedCards().length > 0;
      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && cardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate();

===== Planning #30 @ 227516 =====
uttonText(btn);
      if (!recruitingBtn && /recruit/.test(t)) recruitingBtn = btn;

    return { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons: pool };
  }
  async function handleOcStageEntry(
    stage = getCrimesStageLabel()
  ) {
    if (
      !moduleActive ||
      !isCrimesTab() ||
      (
        stage !== "Recruiting" &&
        stage !== "Planning"
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (stage === lastObservedOcStage) {
      return;
    }

    // Mark entry immediately so MutationObserver rerenders cannot
    // schedule duplicate API calls while this request is in flight.
    lastObservedOcStage = stage;

    markStageScanRequired(stage);
    updateStageVisuals();

    const statusEl =
      document.querySelector(
        ".sakalux-oco-scan-status"
      );

    if (statusEl) {
      statusEl.classList.remove(
        "is-success",
        "is-error"
      );
      statusEl.classList.add(
        "is-scanning"
      );
      statusEl.textContent =
        `Scanning ${stage} members and roles...`;
      statusEl.title =
        `Scanning every ${stage} OC member, role and required item...`;
    }

    const result =
      await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
        stage,
        true
      );

    if (
      result?.ok &&
      result?.stage === stage
    ) {
      markStageScanComplete(stage);
      updateStageVisuals();
      itemTick();
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";

      if (statusEl) {
        flashScanStatus(
          statusEl,
          sessionScanSummary(),
          "success"
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (statusEl) {
      flashScanStatus(
        statusEl,
        result?.reason ||
          "API refresh failed",
        "error",
        2200
      );
    }
  }

  function bindStageAutoRescan() {
    const {
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    } = getStageButtons();

    for (const button of [
      recruitingBtn,
      planningBtn
    ]) {
      if (
        !button ||
        button.dataset
          .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound === "1"
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      button.dataset
        .sakaluxOcoAutoRescanBound = "1";

      button.addEventListener(
        "click",
        () => {
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            handleOcStageEntry(
              getCrimesStageLabel()
            ).catch(error => {
              log(
                "OC stage-entry scan failed:",
                error
              );
            });
          }, 120);
        }
      );
    }
  }

  function updateStageVisuals() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn } = getStageButtons();
    const persistentState =
      readStageScanState();

    sessionScanState.Recruiting =
      !!persistentState.Recruiting.completed;
    sessionScanState.Planning =
      !!persistentState.Planning.completed;

    if (
      sessionScanState.Recruiting &&
      sessionScanState.Planning
    ) {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
    if (recruitingBtn) {
      recruitingBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Recruiting);
      recruitingBtn.title = sessionScanState.Recruiting
        ? "Recruiting - Scan Complete"
        : "Recruiting - Scan Required";
    }
    if (planningBtn) {
      planningBtn.classList.toggle("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned", !!sessionScanState.Planning);
      planningBtn.title = sessionScanState.Planning
        ? "Planning - Scan Complete"
        : "Planning - Scan Required";
    }
  }
  function renderScanStatus(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    el.innerHTML = sessionScanStatusHTML();
    el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
  }

    if (!el) return;

      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
      el.classList.add("is-error");
    } else {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
    }
    el._sakaluxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      renderScanStatus(el);
    }, holdMs);
  }

  function startIntelReadyPoll() {
    if (!moduleActive || intelReadyPoll) return;
    intelReadyPollStartedAt = Date.now();
    intelReadyPoll = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isCrimesTab()) {
        clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
        intelReadyPoll = null;
        return;
      }
      const cardsReady = getNotInvolvedCards().length > 0;
      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && cardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate();
      }
      if (
        onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage ||
        (Date.now() - intelReadyPollStartedAt) > 30000

  function onPageUpdate() {
    if (!moduleActive) return;
    evaluate();
    document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-tab-gear")?.remove();
    const hiddenNativeBox = document.querySelector('div[class*="notInvolvedMembers"][data-sakalux-oco-hidden="1"]');
    if (hiddenNativeBox && !document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-intel-panel")) {
      hiddenNativeBox.style.removeProperty("display");
      delete hiddenNativeBox.dataset.sakaluxOcoHidden;
    }
    if (isCrimesTab()) {
      ensureScanButton();
      refreshNotInOCFromPage();
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();

      const visibleStage =
        getCrimesStageLabel();

      if (
        visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
        visibleStage === "Planning"
      ) {
        handleOcStageEntry(
          visibleStage
        ).catch(err => {
          log(
            "Automatic OC stage-entry scan failed:",
            err
          );
        });
      }
      const intelCardsReady = getNotInvolvedCards().length > 0;
      if (!onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage && intelCardsReady) {
        onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = true;
        refreshOcIntelligence(true).catch(err => {
          onPageUpdate._intelLoadedThisPage = false;
          log("OC Intelligence refresh failed:", err);
        });
      } else if (!intelCardsReady) {
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      }
    }
    if (!isCrimesTab()) {
      lastObservedOcStage = "";
    }

    if (isUtilitiesTab()) {
      clearTimeout(onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer);
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
      ensureLegend();
      applyUtilitiesFlags();
      onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();
      }, 60);
    } else {
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";
    }
  }

  function flashScanStatus(el, text, type, holdMs = 1600) {
    if (!el) return;
    clearTimeout(el._sakaluxTimer);
    el.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error", "is-scanning");
    if (type === "success") {
      renderScanStatus(el);
      el.classList.add("is-success");
    } else if (type === "error") {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
      el.classList.add("is-error");
    } else {
      el.textContent = text;
      el.title = sessionScanTooltip();
    }
    el._sakaluxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      renderScanStatus(el);
    }, holdMs);
  }

  }

            if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return true;
            return (
              node.id === "sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip" ||
              node.id === "sakalux-oco-intel-panel" ||
              node.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-panel") ||
              node.closest?.("#sakalux-oco-intel-tooltip")
            );
          })
        );
      });
      if (onlyIntelUiChanges) return;
      clearTimeout(evalTimer);
      evalTimer = setTimeout(onPageUpdate, OBS_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    });
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    const signal = eventController?.signal;
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
      if (!document.hidden) {
        onPageUpdate();
        startIntelReadyPoll();
      } else {
        closeOcIntelTooltip();
      }
    }, signal ? { signal } : undefined);
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", () => {
      onPageUpdate();
      startIntelReadyPoll();
    }, signal ? { signal } : undefined);
    document.addEventListener("click", e => {
      if (!e.target.closest(".sakalux-oco-has-tooltip")) closeOcIntelTooltip();

      if (isUtilitiesTab() && e.target.closest("a.retrieve")) {
        scheduleUtilitiesMarkerRefresh();
      }
    }, signal ? { capture: true, signal } : true);
    window.addEventListener(
      "scroll",
      closeOcIntelTooltip,
      signal ? { capture: true, passive: true, signal } : true
    );
    window.addEventListener(
      "resize",
      closeOcIntelTooltip,
      signal ? { passive: true, signal } : undefined
    );
    if (itemPollInterval) clearInterval(itemPollInterval);
    itemPollInterval = setInterval(itemTick, ITEM_POLL_MS);
    onPageUpdate();
    startIntelReadyPoll();
  }
  function init() {
    if (moduleActive) return;
    moduleActive = true;
    eventController = new AbortController();
    scriptStartedAt = Date.now();
    addStyles();
    if (!document.body) {
      requestAnimationFrame(init);
      return;
    }
    startObserver();
  }
  sessionScanState.Recruiting = false;
  sessionScanState.Planning = false;
  function destroy() {
    moduleActive = false;
    eventController?.abort();
    eventController = null;
    observer?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    clearTimeout(evalTimer);
    clearTimeout(onPageUpdate._utilitiesTimer);
    if (hudInterval) {
      clearInterval(hudInterval);
      hudInterval = null;
    }
    if (itemPollInterval) {
      clearInterval(itemPollInterval);
      itemPollInterval = null;
    }
    apiOcStagePromises.Recruiting = null;
    apiOcStagePromises.Planning = null;
    apiOcStageLastAt.Recruiting = 0;
    apiOcStageLastAt.Planning = 0;
    lastObservedOcStage = "";
    if (intelReadyPoll) {
      clearInterval(intelReadyPoll);
      intelReadyPoll = null;
    }
    removePopup();
    removeItemAlert();
    removeSettings();
    removeHud();
    closeOcIntelTooltip();
    document.getElementById(STYLE_ID)?.remove();
    document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-tab-gear")?.remove();
    document.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-btn-wrap").forEach(el => el.remove());
    document.getElementById("sakalux-oco-intel-panel")?.remove();
    document.querySelectorAll(
      'div[class*="notInvolvedMembers"][data-sakalux-oco-hidden="1"]'
    ).forEach(box => {
      box.style.removeProperty("display");
      delete box.dataset.sakaluxOcoHidden;
    });
    clearLoanedFlags();
    document.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-stage-scanned").forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove("sakalux-oco-stage-scanned");
      el.removeAttribute("title");
    });
  }
  return {
    init,
    destroy,
    openSettings: showSettings,
    onRouteChange: onPageUpdate
  };

  function itemUsageLines(itemId) {
    const uses = OC_ITEM_USAGE[String(itemId)] || [];
    if (!uses.length) return [];
    const seen = new Set();
    return uses
      .map(u => {
        const note = u.note ? ` (${u.note})` : "";
        return `${u.oc} - ${u.role}${note}`;
      })
      .filter(line => {
        if (seen.has(line)) return false;
        seen.add(line);
        return true;
      });
  }

  const STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY = "sakalux_oco_stage_scan_state_v1";

  function readStageScanState() {
    const saved = store.get(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      {}
    );

    return {
      Recruiting: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Recruiting?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Recruiting?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      },
      Planning: {
        completed:
          !!saved?.Planning?.completed,
        scannedAt:
          Number(
            saved?.Planning?.scannedAt || 0
          )
      }
    };
  }

  function writeStageScanState(stateValue) {
    store.set(
      STAGE_SCAN_STATE_KEY,
      stateValue
    );
  }

  const sessionScanState = {
    Recruiting: false,
    Planning: false
  };

  function markStageScanRequired(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = false;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      ...state[stage],
      completed: false
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function markStageScanComplete(stage) {
    if (
      stage !== "Recruiting" &&
      stage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    sessionScanState[stage] = true;

    const state =
      readStageScanState();

    state[stage] = {
      completed: true,
      scannedAt: now()
    };

    writeStageScanState(state);
  }

  function isAllowedItemId(id) {

  }
  function itemUsageLines(itemId) {
    const uses = OC_ITEM_USAGE[String(itemId)] || [];
    if (!uses.length) return [];
    const seen = new Set();
    return uses
      .map(u => {
        const note = u.note ? ` (${u.note})` : "";
        return `${u.oc} - ${u.role}${note}`;
      })
      .filter(line => {
        if (seen.has(line)) return false;
        seen.add(line);
        return true;
      });
  }
  function buildItemUsageTitle(itemId, lead) {
    const itemName = OC_ITEM_NAMES[String(itemId)] || `Item #${itemId}`;
    const lines = itemUsageLines(itemId);
    const parts = [];
    if (lead) parts.push(lead);
    if (lines.length) {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is used in:\n${lines.map(line => `• ${line}`).join("\n")}`);
    } else {
      parts.push(`${itemName} is included as an OC utility item, but no OC role usage has been mapped yet.`);
    }
    return parts.join("\n\n");
  }

  function hasOcIcon() {
    const directSelectors = [
      'a[aria-label*="Organized Crime" i]',
      'a[aria-label*="Organised Crime" i]',
      'button[aria-label*="Organized Crime" i]',
      'button[aria-label*="Organised Crime" i]',
      '[title*="Organized Crime" i]',
      '[title*="Organised Crime" i]',
      'a[href*="organizedcrimes.php"]',
      'a[href*="organizedCrime"]',
      'a[href*="organized-crime"]'
    ];
    if (directSelectors.some(sel => document.querySelector(sel))) return true;
    const iconAreas = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(
      'div[class^="status-icons"], div[class*="statusIcons"], li[class^="icon"], [class*="status-icon"], [class*="statusIcon"]'
    ));
    return iconAreas.some(area => {
      const text = [
        area.getAttribute("aria-label"),
        area.getAttribute("title"),
        area.textContent
      ].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
      return /organi[sz]ed\s+crime|oc\s*(ready|active|complete|planning|recruiting)/i.test(text);
    });
  }

    );
  }
