  function normalizeUnix(value) {
    const n = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return 0;
    return n > 1e12 ? Math.floor(n / 1000) : Math.floor(n);
  }
  function crimeTier(crime) {
    const values = [crime?.difficulty, crime?.tier, crime?.level, crime?.crime?.difficulty, crime?.crime?.tier, crime?.scenario?.difficulty, crime?.scenario?.tier];
    for (const value of values) {
      const n = Number(value);
      if (Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 10) return Math.round(n);
    }
    const text = [crime?.name, crime?.crime?.name, crime?.scenario?.name, crime?.title].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
    const match = text.match(/\b(?:tier|level|difficulty)\s*([1-9]|10)\b/i);
    return match ? Number(match[1]) : 0;
  }
  function crimeCompletedAt(crime) {
    const values = [crime?.executed_at, crime?.completed_at, crime?.finished_at, crime?.ended_at, crime?.resolution?.completed_at, crime?.timestamps?.completed, crime?.timestamps?.executed, crime?.ready_at].map(normalizeUnix).filter(Boolean);
    return values.length ? Math.max(...values) : 0;
  }
  function crimeStatus(crime) {
    return String(crime?.status || crime?.state || crime?.result?.status || crime?.resolution?.status || "").toLowerCase();
  }
  function crimeMemberIds(crime) {
    const output = new Set();
    const collections = [crime?.slots, crime?.participants, crime?.members, crime?.users, crime?.crew, crime?.crime?.slots];
    const collect = value => {
      if (!value) return;
      if (Array.isArray(value)) { value.forEach(collect); return; }
      if (typeof value !== "object") return;
      const direct = value.user_id ?? value.userId ?? value.member_id ?? value.memberId ?? value.xid ?? value.id;
      if (direct && /^\d+$/.test(String(direct))) output.add(String(direct));
      if (value.user) collect(value.user);
      if (value.member) collect(value.member);
      for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) {
        if (/^\d+$/.test(key) && child && typeof child === "object") output.add(String(key));
        if (child && typeof child === "object" && !["user", "member"].includes(key)) collect(child);
      }
    };
    collections.forEach(collect);
    return [...output];
  }
  function unwrapCrimeList(payload) {
    const candidates = [payload?.crimes, payload?.organized_crimes, payload?.organizedCrimes, payload?.data?.crimes, payload?.data?.organized_crimes, payload?.data];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
      if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        const arr = Object.values(value).filter(v => v && typeof v === "object");
        if (arr.length) return arr;
      }
    }
    return [];
  }
  async function tornApiFetch(path, apiKey) {
    const response = await fetch(`https://api.torn.com/v2${path}`, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: { "Authorization": `ApiKey ${apiKey}`, "Accept": "application/json" },
      credentials: "omit",
      cache: "no-store"
    });
    let data;
    try { data = await response.json(); }
    catch { throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`); }
    const apiError = data?.error || data?.errors?.[0];
    if (!response.ok || apiError) throw new Error(String(apiError?.error || apiError?.message || data?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`));
    return data;
  }
  async function fetchFactionCrimes(apiKey, force = false, pageCount = 4) {
    if (!apiKey) throw new Error("API key not configured");
    const cached = loadLS(OC_API_CACHE_KEY);
    if (!force && cached?.ts && (now() - cached.ts) < OC_API_CACHE_MS && Array.isArray(cached.crimes)) {
      return cached.crimes;
    }
    const all = [];
    let offset = 0;
    const cutoff = Math.floor(now() / 1000) - OC_HISTORY_WINDOW_SECONDS;
    for (let page = 0; page < pageCount; page++) {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        cat: "completed",
        limit: String(OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT),
        offset: String(offset),
        sort: "DESC"
      });
      const payload = await tornApiFetch(`/faction/crimes?${query}`, apiKey);
      const crimes = unwrapCrimeList(payload);
      all.push(...crimes.filter(crime => {
        const completedAt = crimeCompletedAt(crime);
        return !completedAt || completedAt >= cutoff;
      }));
      const oldestCompleted = crimes
        .map(crimeCompletedAt)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) => a - b)[0] || 0;
      if (crimes.length < OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT || (oldestCompleted && oldestCompleted < cutoff)) break;
      offset += OC_API_PAGE_LIMIT;
    }
    saveLS(OC_API_CACHE_KEY, { ts: now(), crimes: all, cutoff });
    return all;
  }
  function apiCrimeStage(crime) {
    const status = crimeStatus(crime);
    if (status.includes("recruit")) return "Recruiting";
    if (status.includes("plan")) return "Planning";
    return "";
  }

  function apiSlotRequirement(slot) {
    const req =
      slot?.item_requirement ||
      slot?.itemRequirement ||
      slot?.required_item ||
      slot?.requiredItem ||
      null;

    if (!req || typeof req !== "object") {
      return null;
    }

    const id =
      req.id ??
      req.item_id ??
      req.itemId ??
      null;

    if (!isAllowedItemId(id)) {
      return null;
    }

    const availabilityValues = [
      req.is_available,
      req.available,
      req.has_item,
      req.hasItem
    ].filter(value => typeof value === "boolean");

    const isAvailable =
      availabilityValues.length
        ? availabilityValues[0]
        : null;

    return {
      id: String(id),
      isAvailable
    };
  }

  function bindOcIntelSorting(panel) {
    const body = panel.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-intel-panel-body");
    if (!body) return;
    panel.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-sort-btn").forEach(btn => {
      if (btn.dataset.sakaluxSortBound === "1") return;
      btn.dataset.sakaluxSortBound = "1";
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const key = btn.dataset.sort;
        const currentKey = panel.dataset.sortKey;
        const currentDir = panel.dataset.sortDir || "desc";
        const nextDir = currentKey === key && currentDir === "desc" ? "asc" : "desc";
        panel.dataset.sortKey = key;
        panel.dataset.sortDir = nextDir;
        panel.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-sort-btn").forEach(b => {
          b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn);
          b.dataset.dir = b === btn ? nextDir : "";
        });
        const rows = Array.from(body.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-intel-panel-row"));
        rows.sort((a, b) => {
          if (key === "name") {
            const av = a.dataset.name || "";
            const bv = b.dataset.name || "";
            return nextDir === "asc" ? av.localeCompare(bv) : bv.localeCompare(av);
          }
          const av = Number(a.dataset[key] || 0);
          const bv = Number(b.dataset[key] || 0);
          return nextDir === "asc" ? av - bv : bv - av;
        });
        rows.forEach(row => body.appendChild(row));
      });
    });
  }

  function convertData(rawData) {
    const converted = {};
    Object.entries(rawData || {}).forEach(([ocName, roles]) => {
      const ocKey = normalize(ocName);
      converted[ocKey] = {};
      Object.entries(roles || {}).forEach(([roleName, value]) => {
        const numberValue = Number(value);
        if (!Number.isFinite(numberValue)) return;
        converted[ocKey][normalize(roleName)] = numberValue;
      });
    });
    return converted;
  }
  function isWeightDataset(data) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== "object") return false;
    const crimes = Object.values(data).filter(
      roles =>
        roles &&
        typeof roles === "object" &&
        Object.values(roles).some(value =>
          Number.isFinite(Number(value))
        )
    );
    return crimes.length > 0;
  }
  function readWeightCache(storage, key) {
    try {
      const cached = JSON.parse(storage.getItem(key) || "null");
      if (
        !cached ||
        !cached.time ||
        !isWeightDataset(cached.data)
      ) {
        return null;
      }
      return cached;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
  function loadCachedData() {
    const sessionCache = readWeightCache(
      sessionStorage,
      CACHE_KEY
    );
    const persistentCache = readWeightCache(
      localStorage,
      PERSISTENT_CACHE_KEY
    );
    const available = [sessionCache, persistentCache]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .sort((a, b) => Number(b.time) - Number(a.time));
    if (!available.length) return false;
    const newest = available[0];
    weightData = newest.data;
    saveCachedData(weightData, Number(newest.time));
    return true;
  }
  function saveCachedData(data, time = Date.now()) {
    if (!isWeightDataset(data)) return false;
    const payload = JSON.stringify({
      time,
      data
    });
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, payload);
    } catch {
    }
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(PERSISTENT_CACHE_KEY, payload);
    } catch {
    }
    return true;
  }
  function clearWeightRetries() {
    weightRetryTimers.forEach(timer => clearTimeout(timer));
    weightRetryTimers = [];
  }
  function scheduleWeightRetries() {
    clearWeightRetries();
    WEIGHT_RETRY_DELAYS.forEach(delay => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        weightRetryTimers = weightRetryTimers.filter(
          current => current !== timer
        );
        if (moduleActive) {
          loadWeights(true);
        }
      }, delay);
      weightRetryTimers.push(timer);
    });
  }
  async function loadWeights(isRetry = false) {
    const hadCachedData = loadCachedData();
    if (hadCachedData) {
      scanPage();
      log("Role weights restored from local cache");
    }
    try {
      const raw = await requestJSON(API_URL);
      const downloaded = convertData(raw);
      if (!isWeightDataset(downloaded)) {
        throw new Error(
          "Role weight endpoint returned an empty dataset"
        );
      }
      weightData = downloaded;
      saveCachedData(weightData);
      clearWeightRetries();
      scanPage();
      log(
        `Role weights loaded for ${
          Object.keys(weightData).length
        } organized crimes`
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        `[${SCRIPT}] Failed to refresh role weights:`,
        error
      );
      if (!isWeightDataset(weightData) && !isRetry) {
        scheduleWeightRetries();
      }
    }
  }

  function getSuccessValue(roleRoot) {

  function getSuccessTier(value) {
    if (value == null) return { key: "mid", grade: "M" };
    if (value <= 49) return { key: "low", grade: "L" };
    if (value <= 64) return { key: "mid", grade: "M" };
    return { key: "high", grade: "H" };
  }
  function getWeightTier(weight) {
    if (weight < 10) return "low";
    if (weight < 20) return "mid";
    return "high";
  }
  function getRolePriority(weight, averageWeight, highestWeight) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(weight) || !Number.isFinite(averageWeight) || averageWeight <= 0) {
      return {
        key: "normal",
        required: 50,
      };
    }
    const relativeToAverage = weight / averageWeight;
    const relativeToHighest = highestWeight > 0 ? weight / highestWeight : 0;
    if (weight >= 35 || relativeToAverage >= 1.65 || relativeToHighest >= 0.90) {
      return {
        key: "critical",
        required: 65,
      };
    }
    if (weight >= 25 || relativeToAverage >= 1.25 || relativeToHighest >= 0.70) {
      return {
        key: "high",
        required: 60,
      };
    }
    if (weight >= 12 || relativeToAverage >= 0.85) {
      return {
        key: "normal",
        required: 50,
      };
    }
    return {
      key: "low",
      required: 0,
    };
  }
  function clampSuitability(value) {
    const numberValue = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(numberValue)) return DEFAULT_SUITABILITY;
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(numberValue)));
  }
  function getSuitabilityThreshold() {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(SUITABILITY_KEY);
    return saved == null ? DEFAULT_SUITABILITY : clampSuitability(saved);
  }
  function getRequiredPass(priority) {
    const score = getSuitabilityThreshold();
    switch (priority?.key) {
      case "critical":
        return Math.round(score * 1.05);
      case "high":
        return Math.round(score);
      case "normal":
        return Math.round(score * 0.95);
      case "low":
        return Math.round(score * 0.90);
      default:
        return Math.round(score * 0.95);
    }
  }
  function getSuitabilityState(successValue, priority) {
    const requiredPass = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, getRequiredPass(priority)));
    const maybePass = Math.max(0, requiredPass - MAYBE_RANGE);
    if (!Number.isFinite(successValue)) {
      return {
        key: "not-suitable",
        label: "✖ Not Suitable",
        requiredPass,
        gap: requiredPass,
      };
    }
    const gap = Math.max(0, requiredPass - successValue);
    if (successValue >= requiredPass) {
      return {
        key: "suitable",
        label: "✔ Suitable",
        requiredPass,
        gap,
      };
    }
    if (successValue >= maybePass) {
      return {
        key: "maybe-suitable",
        label: "⚠ Maybe Suitable",
        requiredPass,
        gap,
      };
    }
    return {
      key: "not-suitable",
      label: "✖ Not Suitable",
      requiredPass,
      gap,
    };
  }

    function loadSettings() {
        try {
            const stored = JSON.parse(
                localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.settings) || "{}"
            );
            return {
                ownUserId:
                    /^\d+$/.test(String(stored.ownUserId || ""))
                        ? String(stored.ownUserId)
                        : "",
                checkInterval: sanitiseInterval(stored.checkInterval),
                targetFlashColor: isHexColour(stored.targetFlashColor)
                    ? stored.targetFlashColor
                    : (
                        isHexColour(stored.flashColor)
                            ? stored.flashColor
                            : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.targetFlashColor
                    ),
                enemyFlashColor: isHexColour(stored.enemyFlashColor)
                    ? stored.enemyFlashColor
                    : (
                        isHexColour(stored.flashColor)
                            ? stored.flashColor
                            : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.enemyFlashColor
                    ),
                flashCount: sanitiseFlashCount(stored.flashCount),
                targetsEnabled: stored.targetsEnabled !== false,
                enemiesEnabled: stored.enemiesEnabled !== false,
                activityAlerts: createAlertSettings(
                    ACTIVITY_STATES,
                    stored.activityAlerts,
                    DEFAULT_SETTINGS.activityAlerts
                ),
                playerStateAlerts: createAlertSettings(
                    PLAYER_STATES,
                    stored.playerStateAlerts,
                    DEFAULT_SETTINGS.playerStateAlerts
                )
            };
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn(`[${SCRIPT_NAME}] Could not load settings.`, error);
            return cloneDefaults();
        }
    }
    function createAlertSettings(states, stored, defaults) {
        const output = {};
        for (const state of states) {
            output[state] =
                typeof stored?.[state] === "boolean"
                    ? stored[state]
                    : Boolean(defaults[state]);
        }
        return output;
    }

    function purgeLegacyApiKey() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(
                STORAGE_KEYS.settings
            );
            if (!raw) return;
            const stored = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (
                !stored ||
                typeof stored !== "object" ||
                !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                    stored,
                    "apiKey"
                )
            ) {
                return;
            }
            delete stored.apiKey;
            localStorage.setItem(
                STORAGE_KEYS.settings,
                JSON.stringify(stored)
            );
        } catch {}
    }

    function loadSettings() {
        try {

                localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.settings) || "{}"
            );
            return {
                ownUserId:
                    /^\d+$/.test(String(stored.ownUserId || ""))
                        ? String(stored.ownUserId)
                        : "",
                checkInterval: sanitiseInterval(stored.checkInterval),
                targetFlashColor: isHexColour(stored.targetFlashColor)
                    ? stored.targetFlashColor
                    : (
                        isHexColour(stored.flashColor)
                            ? stored.flashColor
                            : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.targetFlashColor
                    ),
                enemyFlashColor: isHexColour(stored.enemyFlashColor)
                    ? stored.enemyFlashColor
                    : (
                        isHexColour(stored.flashColor)
                            ? stored.flashColor
                            : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.enemyFlashColor
                    ),
                flashCount: sanitiseFlashCount(stored.flashCount),
                targetsEnabled: stored.targetsEnabled !== false,
                enemiesEnabled: stored.enemiesEnabled !== false,
                activityAlerts: createAlertSettings(
                    ACTIVITY_STATES,
                    stored.activityAlerts,
                    DEFAULT_SETTINGS.activityAlerts
                ),
                playerStateAlerts: createAlertSettings(
                    PLAYER_STATES,
                    stored.playerStateAlerts,
                    DEFAULT_SETTINGS.playerStateAlerts
                )
            };
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn(`[${SCRIPT_NAME}] Could not load settings.`, error);
            return cloneDefaults();
        }
    }
    function createAlertSettings(states, stored, defaults) {
        const output = {};
        for (const state of states) {
            output[state] =
                typeof stored?.[state] === "boolean"
                    ? stored[state]
                    : Boolean(defaults[state]);
        }
        return output;
    }

    function purgeLegacyApiKey() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(
                STORAGE_KEYS.settings
            );
            if (!raw) return;

    }
    function loadPlayerList(type) {
        try {
            const stored = JSON.parse(
                localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS[type]) || "[]"
            );
            if (!Array.isArray(stored)) return [];

                .filter(player => player && /^\d+$/.test(String(player.id)))

    }

    function loadSettings() {
        try {
            const stored = JSON.parse(
                localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.settings) || "{}"
            );
            return {
                ownUserId:
                    /^\d+$/.test(String(stored.ownUserId || ""))
                        ? String(stored.ownUserId)
                        : "",
                checkInterval: sanitiseInterval(stored.checkInterval),
                targetFlashColor: isHexColour(stored.targetFlashColor)
                    ? stored.targetFlashColor
                    : (
                        isHexColour(stored.flashColor)
                            ? stored.flashColor
                            : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.targetFlashColor
                    ),
                enemyFlashColor: isHexColour(stored.enemyFlashColor)
                    ? stored.enemyFlashColor
                    : (
                        isHexColour(stored.flashColor)
                            ? stored.flashColor
                            : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.enemyFlashColor
                    ),
                flashCount: sanitiseFlashCount(stored.flashCount),
                targetsEnabled: stored.targetsEnabled !== false,
                enemiesEnabled: stored.enemiesEnabled !== false,
                activityAlerts: createAlertSettings(
                    ACTIVITY_STATES,
                    stored.activityAlerts,
                    DEFAULT_SETTINGS.activityAlerts
                ),
                playerStateAlerts: createAlertSettings(
                    PLAYER_STATES,
                    stored.playerStateAlerts,
                    DEFAULT_SETTINGS.playerStateAlerts
                )
            };
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn(`[${SCRIPT_NAME}] Could not load settings.`, error);
            return cloneDefaults();
        }
    }
    function createAlertSettings(states, stored, defaults) {
        const output = {};
        for (const state of states) {
            output[state] =
                typeof stored?.[state] === "boolean"
                    ? stored[state]
                    : Boolean(defaults[state]);
        }
        return output;
    }
    function saveSettings() {

    function purgeLegacyApiKey() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(
                STORAGE_KEYS.settings
            );
            if (!raw) return;
            const stored = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (
                !stored ||
                typeof stored !== "object" ||
                !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                    stored,
                    "apiKey"
                )
            ) {
                return;
            }
            delete stored.apiKey;
            localStorage.setItem(
                STORAGE_KEYS.settings,
                JSON.stringify(stored)
            );
        } catch {}
    }
    function loadPlayerList(type) {
        try {
            const stored = JSON.parse(
                localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS[type]) || "[]"
            );
            if (!Array.isArray(stored)) return [];
            return stored
                .filter(player => player && /^\d+$/.test(String(player.id)))
                .map(player => ({
                    id: String(player.id),
                    name:
                        String(player.name || "").trim() ||
                        `Player ${player.id}`,
                    avatar:
                        typeof player.avatar === "string"
                            ? player.avatar
                            : ""
                }));
        } catch {
            return [];
        }
    }

    function sanitiseFlashCount(value) {
        const number = Number.parseInt(value, 10);
        if (!Number.isFinite(number)) {
            return DEFAULT_SETTINGS.flashCount;
        }
        return Math.max(1, Math.min(50, number));
    }
    function sanitiseInterval(value) {

        return INTERVAL_OPTIONS.some(option => option.value === number)
            ? number
            : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.checkInterval;
    }
    function normaliseText(value) {
        return String(value || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    }
    function normaliseState(value) {

            state => state.toLowerCase() === lower
        );
        return known || text;
    }

    function loadSettings() {
        try {
            const stored = JSON.parse(
                localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.settings) || "{}"
            );
            return {
                ownUserId:
                    /^\d+$/.test(String(stored.ownUserId || ""))
                        ? String(stored.ownUserId)
                        : "",
                checkInterval: sanitiseInterval(stored.checkInterval),
                targetFlashColor: isHexColour(stored.targetFlashColor)
                    ? stored.targetFlashColor
                    : (
                        isHexColour(stored.flashColor)
                            ? stored.flashColor
                            : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.targetFlashColor
                    ),
                enemyFlashColor: isHexColour(stored.enemyFlashColor)
                    ? stored.enemyFlashColor
                    : (
                        isHexColour(stored.flashColor)
                            ? stored.flashColor
                            : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.enemyFlashColor
                    ),
                flashCount: sanitiseFlashCount(stored.flashCount),
                targetsEnabled: stored.targetsEnabled !== false,
                enemiesEnabled: stored.enemiesEnabled !== false,
                activityAlerts: createAlertSettings(
                    ACTIVITY_STATES,
                    stored.activityAlerts,
                    DEFAULT_SETTINGS.activityAlerts
                ),
                playerStateAlerts: createAlertSettings(
                    PLAYER_STATES,
                    stored.playerStateAlerts,
                    DEFAULT_SETTINGS.playerStateAlerts
                )
            };
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn(`[${SCRIPT_NAME}] Could not load settings.`, error);
            return cloneDefaults();
        }
    }
    function createAlertSettings(states, stored, defaults) {
        const output = {};
        for (const state of states) {
            output[state] =
                typeof stored?.[state] === "boolean"
                    ? stored[state]
                    : Boolean(defaults[state]);
        }
        return output;
    }

    function purgeLegacyApiKey() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(
                STORAGE_KEYS.settings
            );
            if (!raw) return;
            const stored = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (
                !stored ||
                typeof stored !== "object" ||
                !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                    stored,
                    "apiKey"
                )
            ) {
                return;
            }
            delete stored.apiKey;
            localStorage.setItem(
                STORAGE_KEYS.settings,
                JSON.stringify(stored)
            );
        } catch {}
    }
    function loadPlayerList(type) {
        try {
            const stored = JSON.parse(
                localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS[type]) || "[]"
            );
            if (!Array.isArray(stored)) return [];
            return stored
                .filter(player => player && /^\d+$/.test(String(player.id)))
                .map(player => ({
                    id: String(player.id),
                    name:
                        String(player.name || "").trim() ||
                        `Player ${player.id}`,
                    avatar:
                        typeof player.avatar === "string"
                            ? player.avatar
                            : ""
                }));
        } catch {
            return [];
        }
    }

    function sanitiseFlashCount(value) {
        const number = Number.parseInt(value, 10);
        if (!Number.isFinite(number)) {
            return DEFAULT_SETTINGS.flashCount;
        }
        return Math.max(1, Math.min(50, number));
    }
    function sanitiseInterval(value) {

        return INTERVAL_OPTIONS.some(option => option.value === number)
            ? number

    }

    }
    function normaliseState(value) {

        );
        return known || text;
    }

    function createAlertSettings(states, stored, defaults) {
        const output = {};
        for (const state of states) {
            output[state] =
                typeof stored?.[state] === "boolean"
                    ? stored[state]
                    : Boolean(defaults[state]);
        }
        return output;
    }

    function purgeLegacyApiKey() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(
                STORAGE_KEYS.settings
            );
            if (!raw) return;
            const stored = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (
                !stored ||
                typeof stored !== "object" ||
                !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                    stored,
                    "apiKey"
                )
            ) {
                return;
            }
            delete stored.apiKey;
            localStorage.setItem(
                STORAGE_KEYS.settings,
                JSON.stringify(stored)
            );
        } catch {}
    }
    function loadPlayerList(type) {
        try {

                localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS[type]) || "[]"
            );
            if (!Array.isArray(stored)) return [];

    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? "")
            .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
            .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
            .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")

    }

    function replayPendingPeopleTabAlerts() {
        ensurePeoplePanelTabs();
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            for (const type of [
                "targets",
                "enemies"
            ]) {
                if (
                    !pendingPeopleTabAlerts[type]
                ) {
                    continue;
                }
                const id =
                    type === "targets"
                        ? PEOPLE_PANEL_IDS.targetsTab
                        : PEOPLE_PANEL_IDS.enemiesTab;
                const tab =
                    document.getElementById(id);
                if (!tab) {
                    continue;
                }
                flashPeopleListTab(type);
            }
        });
    }
    function flashPeopleListTab(
        type,
        preview = false
    ) {
        if (!preview && !isTornFocused()) return;
        const id =
            type === "targets"
                ? PEOPLE_PANEL_IDS.targetsTab
                : PEOPLE_PANEL_IDS.enemiesTab;
        const button =
            document.getElementById(id);
        if (!button) {
            return;
        }
        const timerKey =
            `people_${type}_tab`;
        const existingTimer =
            flashTimers.get(timerKey);
        if (existingTimer) {
            clearInterval(existingTimer);
            clearTimeout(existingTimer);
            flashTimers.delete(timerKey);
        }
        const clearFlashOverrides = () => {
            button.style.removeProperty(
                "background"
            );
            button.style.removeProperty(
                "background-color"
            );
            button.style.removeProperty(
                "border-color"
            );
            button.style.removeProperty(
                "box-shadow"
            );
            button.style.removeProperty(
                "filter"
            );
            button.style.removeProperty(
                "transition"
            );
        };
        clearFlashOverrides();
        const flashColor =
            getFlashColorForType(type);
        const flashes =
            Math.max(
                1,
                Number(settings.flashCount) || 10
            );
        let phase = 0;
        button.style.setProperty(
            "transition",
            "background-color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease, filter 120ms ease",
            "important"
        );
        const restore = () => {
            clearFlashOverrides();
            flashTimers.delete(
                timerKey
            );
        };
        const interval =
            setInterval(() => {
                const on =
                    phase % 2 === 0;
                if (on) {
                    button.style.setProperty(
                        "background",
                        flashColor,
                        "important"
                    );
                    button.style.setProperty(
                        "background-color",
                        flashColor,
                        "important"
                    );
                    button.style.setProperty(
                        "border-color",
                        flashColor,
                        "important"
                    );
                    button.style.setProperty(
                        "box-shadow",
                        `0 0 0 2px ${flashColor}, 0 0 12px 3px ${flashColor}`,
                        "important"
                    );
                    button.style.setProperty(
                        "filter",
                        "brightness(1.35)",
                        "important"
                    );
                } else {
                    button.style.removeProperty(
                        "background"
                    );
                    button.style.removeProperty(
                        "background-color"
                    );
                    button.style.removeProperty(
                        "border-color"
                    );
                    button.style.removeProperty(
                        "box-shadow"
                    );
                    button.style.removeProperty(
                        "filter"
                    );
                }
                phase += 1;
                if (phase >= flashes * 2) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    restore();
                }
            }, 220);
        flashTimers.set(
            timerKey,
            interval
        );
    }

    function scheduleNextPoll() {
        if (
            apiBlocked ||
            !isValidApiKey(sharedApiKey)
        ) {
            return;
        }
        clearTimeout(pollTimer);
        const milliseconds = settings.checkInterval * 1000;
        nextCheckAt = Date.now() + milliseconds;
        pollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            pollTimer = null;
            pollAllLists();
        }, milliseconds);
        startCountdown();
    }
    function stopPolling() {
        clearTimeout(pollTimer);
        clearInterval(countdownTimer);
        pollTimer = null;
        countdownTimer = null;
        nextCheckAt = 0;
        updateCountdownDisplay();
    }
    function startCountdown() {
        clearInterval(countdownTimer);
        updateCountdownDisplay();
        countdownTimer = setInterval(
            updateCountdownDisplay,
            1000
        );
    }
    function updateCountdownDisplay() {
        const element = document.getElementById(IDS.nextCheck);
        if (!element) return;
        if (polling) {
            element.textContent = "Checking now";
            return;
        }
        if (
            apiBlocked ||
            !isValidApiKey(sharedApiKey) ||
            !nextCheckAt
        ) {
            element.textContent = "Not scheduled";
            return;
        }
        const seconds = Math.max(
            0,
            Math.ceil((nextCheckAt - Date.now()) / 1000)
        );
        if (seconds <= 0) {
            element.textContent = "Due now";
            return;
        }
        const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
        const remainder = seconds % 60;
        element.textContent =
            minutes > 0
                ? `${minutes}m ${String(remainder).padStart(2, "0")}s`
                : `${seconds}s`;
    }

    function destroy() {

    function isPCStandardView() {
      const ua = String(navigator.userAgent || "").toLowerCase();
      const mobile =
        /tornpda|torn pda|android|iphone|ipad|ipod|mobile/.test(ua);

      if (mobile) return false;

      return window.matchMedia("(min-width: 701px)").matches;
    }

    function openPcTagEditor(member) {
      document.getElementById("sakalux-fmv-pc-tag-editor")?.remove();
      const editor = document.createElement("div");
      editor.id = "sakalux-fmv-pc-tag-editor";

          <header>
            <div>
              <strong>${esc(member.name)}</strong>
              <small>Member Tags</small>
            </div>
            <button type="button" data-pc-tag-close aria-label="Close">×</button>

                style="--sakalux-pc-tag:${esc(safeColor(item.color, "#94A3B8"))}"

            `).join("") || `<div class="sakalux-fmv-pc-tag-empty">No manual tags configured.</div>`}
          </div>
          <footer>

            <button type="button" class="primary" data-pc-tag-close>Done</button>
          </footer>
        </section>
      `;
      document.body.appendChild(editor);

      const close = () => editor.remove();
      editor.querySelectorAll("[data-pc-tag-close]").forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", close);
      });
      editor.addEventListener("mousedown", event => {
        if (event.target === editor) close();
      });
      editor.querySelectorAll("[data-pc-tag-option]").forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const tag = String(button.dataset.pcTagOption || "");
          if (!tag) return;
          const selected = manualTags(member.id);
          state.tags[String(member.id)] = selected.includes(tag)
            ? selected.filter(item => item !== tag)
            : [...selected, tag];
          saveJSON(TAG_STORAGE, state.tags);
          button.classList.toggle("active");
          window.dispatchEvent(new Event("sakalux-country-flags-updated"));
        });
      });
      editor.querySelector("[data-pc-tag-clear]")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        state.tags[String(member.id)] = [];
        saveJSON(TAG_STORAGE, state.tags);
        editor.querySelectorAll("[data-pc-tag-option]").forEach(button => {
          button.classList.remove("active");
        });
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("sakalux-country-flags-updated"));
      });
    }

    function openPcTagEditor(member) {
      document.getElementById("sakalux-fmv-pc-tag-editor")?.remove();
      const editor = document.createElement("div");
      editor.id = "sakalux-fmv-pc-tag-editor";
      editor.className = "sakalux-fmv-pc-tag-editor";
      const current = manualTags(member.id);
      editor.innerHTML = `
        <section class="sakalux-fmv-pc-tag-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Edit member tags">
          <header>
            <div>
              <strong>${esc(member.name)}</strong>
              <small>Member Tags</small>
            </div>
            <button type="button" data-pc-tag-close aria-label="Close">×</button>
          </header>
          <div class="sakalux-fmv-pc-tag-options">
            ${tagDefinitions().map(item => `
              <button
                type="button"
                class="${current.includes(item.name) ? "active" : ""}"
                data-pc-tag-option="${esc(item.name)}"
                style="--sakalux-pc-tag:${esc(safeColor(item.color, "#94A3B8"))}"
                title="${esc(item.name)}"
              >
                <b>${esc(item.short || item.name)}</b>
                <small>${esc(item.name)}</small>
              </button>
            `).join("") || `<div class="sakalux-fmv-pc-tag-empty">No manual tags configured.</div>`}
          </div>
          <footer>
            <button type="button" data-pc-tag-clear>Clear Manual Tags</button>
            <button type="button" class="primary" data-pc-tag-close>Done</button>
          </footer>
        </section>
      `;
      document.body.appendChild(editor);

      const close = () => editor.remove();
      editor.querySelectorAll("[data-pc-tag-close]").forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", close);
      });
      editor.addEventListener("mousedown", event => {
        if (event.target === editor) close();
      });
      editor.querySelectorAll("[data-pc-tag-option]").forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const tag = String(button.dataset.pcTagOption || "");
          if (!tag) return;
          const selected = manualTags(member.id);
          state.tags[String(member.id)] = selected.includes(tag)
            ? selected.filter(item => item !== tag)
            : [...selected, tag];
          saveJSON(TAG_STORAGE, state.tags);
          button.classList.toggle("active");
          window.dispatchEvent(new Event("sakalux-country-flags-updated"));
        });
      });
      editor.querySelector("[data-pc-tag-clear]")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        state.tags[String(member.id)] = [];
        saveJSON(TAG_STORAGE, state.tags);
        editor.querySelectorAll("[data-pc-tag-option]").forEach(button => {
          button.classList.remove("active");
        });
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("sakalux-country-flags-updated"));
      });
    }

            ? selected.filter(item => item !== tag)

        });

      });

    function mount() {
      if (!moduleActive) return false;
      const page = pageContext();
      if (!page) {
        restoreNative();
        return false;
      }
      if (activePageKey && activePageKey !== page.key) {
        restoreNative();
        state.members = [];
      }
      activePageKey = page.key;

      if (isPCStandardView()) {
        restoreNative();
        return false;

    function scheduleMount(delay = 80) {
      clearTimeout(routeTimer);
      routeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (!moduleActive) return;
        if (isPCStandardView()) {
          stopObserver();
          restoreNative();
          return;
        }
        if (mount()) stopObserver();
        else startObserver();
      }, delay);
    }
    function startObserver() {
      if (observer || !pageContext() || !moduleActive || isPCStandardView()) return;
      observer = new MutationObserver(records => { if (!window.SakaLuXPerf?.unrelated?.(records)) scheduleMount(60); });
      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
    function stopObserver() {
      observer?.disconnect();
      observer = null;
    }

    function onWarRatingsUpdated() {
      if (document.getElementById(APP_ID)) render();
    }
    function onStorage(event) {
      if ([COUNTRY_STORAGE, WAR_RATING_STORAGE, TAG_STORAGE].includes(event.key)) {
        if (event.key === TAG_STORAGE) state.tags = loadJSON(TAG_STORAGE, {});
        render();
      }
    }
    let editTagsHandler=null;
    function init() {
      moduleActive = true;
      moduleSettings();
      saveSettings();
      saveJSON(TAG_STORAGE, state.tags);
      saveJSON(PROFILE_FIELD_STORAGE, state.profileFields);
      addStyles();

      countrySubsystem.init();

      window.addEventListener("sakalux:war-ratings-updated", onWarRatingsUpdated);
      window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage);
      editTagsHandler=event => {
        const detail = event?.detail || {};
        const member = {
          id: Number(detail.userId || 0),
          name: String(detail.name || `Player ${detail.userId || ""}`)
        };
        if (member.id) openPcTagEditor(member);
      };
      window.addEventListener("sakalux:faction-member-edit-tags",editTagsHandler);
      scheduleMount(0);

    }
    function destroy() {
      moduleActive = false;
      clearTimeout(routeTimer);
      clearTimeout(searchTimer);

      countrySubsystem.destroy();

      stopObserver();
      restoreNative();
      window.removeEventListener("sakalux:war-ratings-updated", onWarRatingsUpdated);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage);
      if(editTagsHandler)window.removeEventListener("sakalux:faction-member-edit-tags",editTagsHandler);
      editTagsHandler=null;
      document.getElementById(STYLE_ID)?.remove();
      document.querySelector(`#${SUITE.panelId} .sakalux-fmv-settings-layer`)?.remove();
    }
    return {
      init,
      openSettings,
      onRouteChange() {
        if (!moduleActive) return;
        countrySubsystem.onRouteChange();
        scheduleMount(40);
      },
      onSharedApiKeyChange() {
        if (!moduleActive || !document.getElementById(APP_ID)) return;
        refresh(true);
      },
      reloadSettings() {
        if (document.getElementById(APP_ID)) render();
        countrySubsystem.onRouteChange();
      },
      destroy
    };
  }

    function updateFlagIcon(container, userId) {
        const trigger = container.querySelector('.sakalux-flag-trigger');
        if (!trigger) return;
        const data = getCountryDataForUser(userId);
        const nextCode = data?.code || "";
        const nextName = data?.name || "";
        container.title = data
            ? `${data.name} - click to change`
            : "Click to choose a country";
        trigger.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            data ? `Country: ${data.name}` : "Click to choose a country"
        );
        if (
            container.dataset.countryCode === nextCode &&
            container.dataset.countryName === nextName &&
            trigger.firstElementChild
        ) {
            return;
        }
        container.dataset.countryCode = nextCode;
        container.dataset.countryName = nextName;
        trigger.innerHTML = data?.code
            ? `<img src="${getFlagImageUrl(data.code)}" alt="${escapeHtml(data.name)}" class="sakalux-country-flag-img">`
            : `<span class="sakalux-country-flag-placeholder">+</span>`;
    }

    function getCandidateCells(row) {
        let cells = Array.from(row.children || []).filter(el => {
            const tag = el.tagName?.toLowerCase();
            return tag === 'li' || tag === 'td' || tag === 'div';
        });
        if (cells.length < 4) {
            cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('li, td, .table-cell, [class*="cell"]'));
        }
        return cells;
    }
    function looksLikeDaysValue(text) {
        const t = String(text || '').trim();
        if (!/^\d{1,5}$/.test(t)) return false;
        const n = Number(t);
        return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n <= 10000;
    }
    function findDaysCell(record) {
        const row = record.row;
        if (!row) return null;
        const directDays = row.querySelector(
            '.table-cell.days, li.table-cell.days, div.table-cell.days'
        );
        if (directDays) {
            const stored =
                directDays.dataset.sakaluxOriginalDays ||
                directDays.querySelector(
                    ".sakalux-country-days-number"
                )?.textContent ||
                directDays.textContent ||
                "";
            if (looksLikeDaysValue(String(stored).trim())) {
                return directDays;
            }
        }
        const cells = getCandidateCells(row);
        if (!cells.length) return null;
        const statusIndex = cells.findIndex(cell => {
            const text = (cell.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            return (
                text.includes('okay') ||
                text.includes('trav') ||
                text.includes('hos') ||
                text.includes('jail') ||
                text.includes('federal') ||
                text.includes('abroad')
            );
        });
        if (statusIndex > 0) {
            for (let i = statusIndex - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const cell = cells[i];
                const original = cell.dataset.sakaluxOriginalDays || cell.textContent || '';
                if (looksLikeDaysValue(original)) return cell;
            }
        }
        for (const cell of cells) {
            const original = cell.dataset.sakaluxOriginalDays || cell.textContent || '';
            if (looksLikeDaysValue(original)) return cell;
        }
        return null;
    }
    function updateCountryDaysHeaders() {
        const possibleHeaders = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('li, th, td, div, span'));
        possibleHeaders.forEach(header => {
            if (header.dataset.sakaluxCountryDaysHeader === '1') return;
            const text = (header.textContent || '').trim();
            if (text !== 'Days') return;
            const parentText = (header.parentElement?.textContent || '').toLowerCase();
            const likelyFactionHeader =
                parentText.includes('lvl') &&
                parentText.includes('ff') &&
                parentText.includes('status');
            if (!likelyFactionHeader) return;
            header.dataset.sakaluxCountryDaysHeader = '1';
            header.innerHTML = `
                <div class="sakalux-country-days-header">
                    <span class="sakalux-country-title">Country</span>
                    <span class="sakalux-days-title">Days</span>
                </div>
            `;
        });
    }

    function startPdaWatchdog() {
        if (!isPdaLayout() || pdaWatchdogTimer) return;
        pdaWatchdogTimer = setInterval(() => {
            if (!moduleActive || !isOnInfoTab()) return;
            const records = getAllMemberRecords();
            const memberCount = records.length;
            const flagCount = document.querySelectorAll(`.${FLAG_CLASS}[data-user-id]`).length;
            const hasSearchButton = !!document.querySelector('button[aria-controls="member-search-input"], button[class*="searchButton"]');
            const hasMapButton = !!document.getElementById(MAP_BTN_ID);
            const tableChanged = memberCount !== pdaLastKnownMemberCount;
            const missingFlags = memberCount > 0 && flagCount < Math.max(1, Math.floor(memberCount * 0.6));
            const missingMapButton = hasSearchButton && !hasMapButton;
            const stale = Date.now() - lastStableRunAt > 8000;
            const missingPicker = !document.getElementById(PICKER_ID);
            pdaLastKnownMemberCount = memberCount;
            if (tableChanged || missingFlags || missingMapButton || missingPicker || stale) {
                schedulePdaReinject('watchdog');
            }
        }, 5000);
    }
    function bindPdaStabilityEvents() {

            { capture: true, signal }

        );

            'touchend',
            () => {
                clearTimeout(touchTimer);
                touchTimer = setTimeout(
                    () => schedulePdaReinject('touchend'),
                    420
                );
            },
            { capture: true, signal }
        );
        document.addEventListener(
            'visibilitychange',
            () => {

                }
            },
            { capture: true, signal }
        );
    }

    function restoreOriginalMemberOrder() {
        const rows = getMemberRows();
        if (!rows.length) return;
        const parent = rows[0]?.parentElement;
        if (!parent) return;
        [...rows]
            .sort(
                (a, b) =>
                    parseInt(
                        a.dataset.sakaluxOriginalIndex ?? "0",
                        10
                    ) -
                    parseInt(
                        b.dataset.sakaluxOriginalIndex ?? "0",
                        10
                    )
            )
            .forEach(row => {
                parent.appendChild(row);
                delete row.dataset.sakaluxOriginalIndex;
            });
    }

    function scheduleScan(delay = 700) {
        if (!moduleActive) return;
        if (scanTimer) return;
        scanTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            scanTimer = null;
            if (moduleActive) runScan();
        }, delay);
    }
    async function runScan() {
        if (!moduleActive || running) return;
        running = true;
        try {
            injectStyles();
            const rows = readStatusRows();
            if (!rows.length) return;
            rows.forEach(record => {
                const days = readDays(record);
                if (days !== null) {
                    setStatusLines(record.statusCell, null, `${days}d`);
                    if (days >= 1) {
                        applyRowColor(record.row, days);
                    }
                }
            });
            if (!ENABLE_API_UPGRADE) return;
            if (lastApiFailAt && Date.now() - lastApiFailAt < API_FAIL_COOLDOWN_MS) return;
            const apiKey = getApiKey();
            if (!apiKey) return;
            const data = await getFactionApiData(apiKey);
            if (!data || data.error || !data.members) {
                lastApiFailAt = Date.now();
                console.warn("[SakaLuX Activity Intel] API error:", data);
                return;
            }
            const apiMembers = Object.entries(data.members).map(([id, member]) => ({
                id,
                member,
                nameKey: normalizeName(member?.name || "")
            }));

    function readStatusRows() {
        const cells = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div.table-cell.status, .table-cell.status'));
        const records = [];
        cells.forEach(cell => {
            const statusText = getStatusText(cell);
            if (!/^(Okay|Traveling|Travelling|Abroad|Hospital|Jail|Federal|Fallen)/i.test(statusText)) return;
            const row = statusRow(cell);
            const daysCell = row ? daysCellFor(row, cell) : null;
            records.push({
                statusCell: cell,
                row,
                daysCell,
                profileID: row ? getUserID(row) : "",
                name: row ? getMemberName(row) : ""
            });
        });
        return records;
    }
    function statusRow(statusCell) {
        let el = statusCell;
        for (let i = 0; i < 18 && el && el !== document.body; i++) {
            const cells = rowCells(el);
            if (cells.length >= 5 && cells.some(c => c === statusCell || c.contains(statusCell))) {
                return el;
            }
            el = el.parentElement;
        }
        return statusCell.closest('li.table-row, tr, [class*="table-row"], [class*="tableRow"]');
    }
    function rowCells(row) {
        return Array.from(row.children || []).filter(el => {
            const tag = (el.tagName || '').toLowerCase();
            return tag === 'li' || tag === 'td' || tag === 'div';
        });
    }
    function daysCellFor(row, statusCell) {
        const cells = rowCells(row);
        const statusIndex = cells.findIndex(c => c === statusCell || c.contains(statusCell));
        if (statusIndex > 0) {
            for (let i = statusIndex - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const days = readDaysCell(cells[i]);
                if (days !== null) return cells[i];
            }
        }
        const stored = row.querySelector('[data-sakalux-original-days]');
        if (stored && readDaysCell(stored) !== null) return stored;
        return null;
    }

        if (!record.daysCell) return null;

    }

    }

    function fetchWithTimeout(url, timeout) {
        const controller = new AbortController();

    function rememberRowBackground(row) {
        if (!row || touchedRows.has(row)) return;
        touchedRows.set(row, {
            value: row.style.getPropertyValue("background-color"),
            priority: row.style.getPropertyPriority("background-color")
        });
    }
    function restoreRowBackground(row) {
        if (!row) return;
        const original = touchedRows.get(row);
        if (!original) {
            row.style.removeProperty("background-color");
            return;
        }
        if (original.value) {
            row.style.setProperty(
                "background-color",
                original.value,
                original.priority || ""
            );
        } else {
            row.style.removeProperty("background-color");
        }
    }
    function applyRowColor(row, days) {
        const color = getHighlightColor(days);
        if (color && row) {
            rememberRowBackground(row);
            row.style.setProperty('background-color', color, 'important');
        }
    }

    function shortenLastAction(text) {
        return String(text || '')
            .replace(/minutes? ago/i, 'm')
            .replace(/hours? ago/i, 'h')
            .replace(/days? ago/i, 'd')
            .replace(/\s+/g, '')
            .trim();
    }
    function getDaysInactive(timestamp) {
        return Math.floor((Date.now() / 1000 - Number(timestamp)) / 86400);
    }
    function formatStatusTimer(until) {
        if (!until) return "";
        const secondsLeft = Number(until) - Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
        if (secondsLeft <= 0) return "";
        const mins = Math.ceil(secondsLeft / 60);
        const days = Math.floor(mins / 1440);
        const hours = Math.floor((mins % 1440) / 60);
        const minutes = mins % 60;
        if (days > 0) return `${days}d`;
        if (hours > 0) return `${hours}h`;
        return `${minutes}m`;
    }
    function mapLocationCode(location) {
        const clean = String(location || "").replace(/\.\.\.$/, "").replace(/\.$/, "").trim();
        const lower = clean.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.startsWith("british")) return "UK";
        if (lower.startsWith("united kingdom")) return "UK";
        if (lower.startsWith("canada")) return "CAN";
        if (lower.startsWith("torn")) return "Torn";
        if (lower.startsWith("switzerland")) return "SWZ";
        if (lower.startsWith("swiss")) return "SWZ";
        if (lower.startsWith("mexico")) return "MEX";
        if (lower.startsWith("cayman")) return "CAY";
        if (lower.startsWith("uae")) return "UAE";
        if (lower.startsWith("south af")) return "SA";
        if (lower.startsWith("hawaii")) return "HAW";
        if (lower.startsWith("japan")) return "JPN";
        if (lower.startsWith("argentina")) return "ARG";
        if (lower.startsWith("china")) return "CHN";
        return shortLocations[clean] || clean;
    }
    function cleanLocationName(text) {
        const location = String(text || "")
            .replace(/^Traveling from\s+.+?\s+to\s+/i, "")
            .replace(/^Travelling from\s+.+?\s+to\s+/i, "")
            .replace(/^Traveling to\s+/i, "")
            .replace(/^Travelling to\s+/i, "")
            .replace(/^Traveling\s+/i, "")
            .replace(/^Travelling\s+/i, "")
            .replace(/^Flying to\s+/i, "")
            .replace(/^Hospitalized?\s+(?:in|at)\s+/i, "")
            .replace(/^Hospital\s+(?:in|at)\s+/i, "")
            .replace(/^Jailed?\s+(?:in|at)\s+/i, "")
            .replace(/^In\s+/i, "")
            .replace(/\.$/, "")
            .trim();
        return mapLocationCode(location);
    }

    function getCompactStatusExtra(member) {
        const status = member.status || {};
        const state = String(status.state || "").toLowerCase();
        const desc = String(status.description || status.details || "").trim();
        const timer = formatStatusTimer(status.until);
        const location = extractStatusLocation(desc);

        if (state.includes("travel")) {
            return location || timer || "";
        }

        if (state.includes("abroad")) {
            return location && location !== "Torn"
                ? location
                : "";
        }

        if (state.includes("hospital") || state.includes("jail")) {
            const abroad = location && location !== "Torn"
                ? location
                : "";
            if (timer && abroad) return `${timer} - ${abroad}`;
            if (timer) return timer;
            if (abroad) return abroad;
            return "";
        }

        return timer || "";
    }

  function getStartValue() {
    const hash = String(location.hash || "");
    const match = hash.match(/(?:^|[#/&?])start=([^&#/]+)/i);
    const raw = match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : "0";

      function groupEvents(events) {
          const map = new Map();
          events.forEach(event => {
              if (!map.has(event.date)) {
                  map.set(event.date, []);
              }
              map.get(event.date).push(event);
          });
          return [...map.entries()]
              .map(([date, groupEvents]) => {
                  const label = getDateLabel(date);
                  return {
                      date,
                      label,
                      events: groupEvents
                  };
              });
      }
      function getDateLabel(date) {
          const parts =
              date.split('/')
                  .map(Number);
          if (parts.length !== 3) {
              return date;
          }
          let [
              day,
              month,
              year
          ] = parts;
          if (year < 100) {
              year += 2000;
          }
          const eventDate =
              new Date(
                  year,
                  month - 1,
                  day
              );
          const today =
              new Date();
          eventDate.setHours(
              0, 0, 0, 0
          );
          today.setHours(
              0, 0, 0, 0
          );
          const yesterday =
              new Date(today);
          yesterday.setDate(
              yesterday.getDate() - 1
          );
          if (
              eventDate.getTime() ===
              today.getTime()
          ) {
              return 'TODAY';
          }
          if (
              eventDate.getTime() ===
              yesterday.getTime()
          ) {
              return 'YESTERDAY';
          }
          return date;
      }

  function stopDashboard() {
          state.observer?.disconnect();

          clearTimeout(state.refreshTimer);

              const buttons = row.querySelector('[class*="buttonsGroup"]');
              buttons?.classList.remove('ax-pda-native-event-buttons');

                  ?.classList.remove('ax-pda-native-event-send');
              state.nativeList?.appendChild(row);
          });

          state.nativeList = null;
          state.pdaLastSignature = '';
          state.pdaLastUrl = location.href;
      }

    function fmtMoney(n) {
        if (n >= 1_000_000_000) return `$${(n / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(2)}B`;
        if (n >= 1_000_000)     return `$${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;

    }
    function parseMoney(str) {
        if (!str) return 0;
        const s = str.replace(/[$,\s]/g, "");
        if (s.endsWith("B")) return parseFloat(s) * 1_000_000_000;
        if (s.endsWith("M")) return parseFloat(s) * 1_000_000;
        return parseInt(s.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""), 10) || 0;
    }
    function parseExpenseValue(str) {
        if (!str) return 0;

        return parseInt(cleaned.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""), 10) || 0;
    }
    function formatFullMoney(n) {
        const value = Number(n) || 0;
        return `$${Math.round(value).toLocaleString()}`;
    }
    function parseSignedMoneyValue(str) {
        if (!str) return 0;
        let s = String(str).trim();
        const negative = /^\s*-/.test(s) || /-\s*\$/.test(s);
        s = s.replace(/[$,\s+]/g, "").replace(/[^0-9.\-BMK]/gi, "").replace(/^-/, "");
        const mult = /B$/i.test(s) ? 1_000_000_000 : /M$/i.test(s) ? 1_000_000 : /K$/i.test(s) ? 1_000 : 1;
        const val = parseFloat(s.replace(/[BMK]/ig, "")) || 0;
        return (negative ? -1 : 1) * val * mult;
    }
    function formatSignedMoney(n) {

    }

    function calcStdDev(values) {
        const nums = values.map(Number).filter(v => !isNaN(v));
        if (nums.length <= 1) return 0;
        const avg = nums.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / nums.length;
        const variance = nums.reduce((sum, v) => sum + Math.pow(v - avg, 2), 0) / nums.length;
        return Math.sqrt(variance);
    }
    function consistencyGrade(avg, stdDev, partPct = 100, zeroRate = 0, recentNoHit = 0, currentHitStreak = 0) {
        const participation = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(partPct) || 0));
        const zeros = Math.max(0, Number(zeroRate) || 0);
        const recentZeros = Math.max(0, Number(recentNoHit) || 0);
        const streak = Math.max(0, Number(currentHitStreak) || 0);
        const avgHits = Number(avg) || 0;
        const dev = Number(stdDev) || 0;
        const cv = avgHits ? dev / avgHits : 0;
        let score = 100;
        score -= Math.max(0, 100 - participation) * 0.45;
        score -= zeros * 0.30;
        score -= recentZeros * 8;
        if (streak >= 10) score += 5;
        if (avgHits > 0 && cv > 1.2) score -= 6;
        score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(score)));
        if (score >= 94) return "A+";
        if (score >= 84) return "A";
        if (score >= 72) return "B";
        if (score >= 56) return "C";
        return "D";
    }
    function consistencyHint(grade) {
        return ({
            "A+": "Elite",
            "A": "Stable",
            "B": "Good",
            "C": "Variable",
            "D": "Erratic",
            "-": "Not enough data"
        })[grade] || "Not enough data";
    }

    async function doFetch(inputId, warId) {
        const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
        const url = input?.value?.trim();
        if (!url || !url.includes("armasync")) {
            setAARStatus("⚠ Please enter a valid TC ArmaSync payout URL.", "warn"); return;
        }
        const reportIdMatch = url.match(/payout-results\/([^/?#]+)/);
        const reportId = reportIdMatch?.[1] || `${warId}-${Date.now()}`;
        setAARStatus("⬇ Fetching from ArmaSync…", "loading");
        disableFetchBtns(true);
        try {
            const html = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                    method   : "GET",
                    url      : url,
                    headers  : { "Accept": "text/html,*/*" },
                    onload   : r => {
                        if (r.status >= 200 && r.status < 300) resolve(r.responseText);
                        else reject(new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`));
                    },
                    onerror  : () => reject(new Error("Network error - check your connection.")),
                    ontimeout: () => reject(new Error("Request timed out.")),
                    timeout  : 15000
                });
            });
            setAARStatus("🔍 Parsing war data…", "loading");
            const data = parseArmaSync(html, reportId, url);
            if (!data.members.length) {
                throw new Error("No member data found. Make sure the URL is a valid ArmaSync payout results page.");
            }
            const all = store.get(AAR_KEY, {});
            const saveKey = `${warId}-${reportId}`;
            all[saveKey]  = data;
            store.set(AAR_KEY, all);
            const wrap = document.getElementById("aar-report-wrap");
            if (wrap) { wrap.innerHTML = renderReport(data); wrap.style

    async function doFetch(inputId, warId) {
        const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
        const url = input?.value?.trim();
        if (!url || !url.includes("armasync")) {
            setAARStatus("⚠ Please enter a valid TC ArmaSync payout URL.", "warn"); return;
        }
        const reportIdMatch = url.match(/payout-results\/([^/?#]+)/);
        const reportId = reportIdMatch?.[1] || `${warId}-${Date.now()}`;
        setAARStatus("⬇ Fetching from ArmaSync…", "loading");
        disableFetchBtns(true);
        try {
            const html = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                    method   : "GET",
                    url      : url,
                    headers  : { "Accept": "text/html,*/*" },
                    onload   : r => {
                        if (r.status >= 200 && r.status < 300) resolve(r.responseText);
                        else reject(new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`));
                    },
                    onerror  : () => reject(new Error("Network error - check your connection.")),
                    ontimeout: () => reject(new Error("Request timed out.")),
                    timeout  : 15000
                });
            });
            setAARStatus("🔍 Parsing war data…", "loading");
            const data = parseArmaSync(html, reportId, url);
            if (!data.members.length) {
                throw new Error("No member data found. Make sure the URL is a valid ArmaSync payout results page.");
            }
            const all = store.get(AAR_KEY, {});
            const saveKey = `${warId}-${reportId}`;
            all[saveKey]  = data;
            store.set(AAR_KEY, all);
            const wrap = document.getElementById("aar-report-wrap");
            if (wrap) { wrap.innerHTML = renderReport(data); wrap.style.display = ""; wireReportInteractivity(data, wrap); }
            const collBody = document.getElementById("aar-collapsible");
            if (collBody) collBody.style.display = "";
            const collBtn = document.getElementById("aar-collapse-btn");
            if (collBtn) { collBtn.textContent = "▲"; collBtn.title = "Collapse"; }
            ["aar-fetch-zone", "aar-refetch-row"].forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.style.display = "none";
            });
            if (!document.getElementById("aar-del-btn")) {
                const topRight = document.querySelector(".aar-topbar-right");
                if (topRight) {
                    const db = document.createElement("button");
                    db.className = "aar-del-btn"; db.id = "aar-del-btn"; db.title = "Delete saved report"; db.textContent = "🗑";
                    topRight.appendChild(db);
                    db.addEventListener("click", () => {
                        if (!confirm("Delete this saved report?")) return;
                        const all = store.get(AAR_KEY, {});
                        delete all[saveKey];
                        store.set(AAR_KEY, all);
                        document.getElementById(AAR_SECTION_ID)?.remove();
                        ensureAARSection();
                    });
                }
            }
            const topLeft = document.querySelector(".aar-topbar-left");
            if (topLeft && !topLeft.querySelector(".aar-saved-stamp")) {
                const stamp = document.createElement("span");
                stamp.className = "aar-saved-stamp";
                stamp.textContent = "✔ Report saved";
                topLeft.appendChild(stamp);
            }
            setAARStatus(`✔ ${data.members.length} members parsed and saved.`, "success", 4000);
        } catch (err) {
            setAARStatus(`✘ ${err.message}`, "error");
        } finally {
            disableFetchBtns(false);
        }
    }
    function disableFetchBtns(state) {

    function setAARStatus(msg, type, autoClearMs = 0) {
        const el = document.getElementById("aar-status");
        if (!el) return;
        el.style.display = "";
        el.className     = `aar-status aar-status-${type}`;
        el.textContent   = msg;
        if (autoClearMs) setTimeout(() => { el.style.display = "none"; }, autoClearMs);
    }
    function getFactionWarfareRankedFactionId() {
        const match = (location.hash || location.href).match(/#\/ranked\/(\d+)/i);
        return match?.[1] || "unknown";
    }
    function getCurrentRankWarId() {
        const qsRankId = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("rankID");
        if (qsRankId) return qsRankId;
        const hrefMatch = location.href.match(/[?&#]rankID=(\d+)/i);
        if (hrefMatch) return hrefMatch[1];
        const reportLink = document.querySelector('a[href*="war.php?step=rankreport"][href*="rankID="], a[href*="rankID="]');
        const reportHref = reportLink?.getAttribute("href") || "";
        const linkMatch = reportHref.match(/rankID=(\d+)/i);
        if (linkMatch) return linkMatch[1];
        const titleText = [
            document.querySelector(".title-black")?.textContent,
            document.querySelector("[class*='title-black']")?.textContent,
            document.querySelector("[class*='war-title']")?.textContent,
            document.title
        ].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
        const titleMatch = titleText.match(/(?:War|Ranked War)\s*#?\s*(\d{3,})/i);
        if (titleMatch) return titleMatch[1];
        return `manual-${Date.now()}`;
    }

    async function doFetch(inputId, warId) {
        const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
        const url = input?.value?.trim();
        if (!url || !url.includes("armasync")) {
            setAARStatus("⚠ Please enter a valid TC ArmaSync payout URL.", "warn"); return;
        }
        const reportIdMatch = url.match(/payout-results\/([^/?#]+)/);
        const reportId = reportIdMatch?.[1] || `${warId}-${Date.now()}`;
        setAARStatus("⬇ Fetching from ArmaSync…", "loading");
        disableFetchBtns(true);
        try {
            const html = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                    method   : "GET",
                    url      : url,
                    headers  : { "Accept": "text/html,*/*" },
                    onload   : r => {
                        if (r.status >= 200 && r.status < 300) resolve(r.responseText);
                        else reject(new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`));
                    },
                    onerror  : () => reject(new Error("Network error - check your connection.")),
                    ontimeout: () => reject(new Error("Request timed out.")),
                    timeout  : 15000
                });
            });
            setAARStatus("🔍 Parsing war data…", "loading");
            const data = parseArmaSync(html, reportId, url);
            if (!data.members.length) {
                throw new Error("No member data found. Make sure the URL is a valid ArmaSync payout results page.");
            }
            const all = store.get(AAR_KEY, {});
            const saveKey = `${warId}-${reportId}`;
            all[saveKey]  = data;
            store.set(AAR_KEY, all);
            const wrap = document.getElementById("aar-report-wrap");
            if (wrap) { wrap.innerHTML = renderReport(data); wrap.style.display = ""; wireReportInteractivity(data, wrap); }
            const collBody = document.getElementById("aar-collapsible");
            if (collBody) collBody.style.display = "";
            const collBtn = document.getElementById("aar-collapse-btn");
            if (collBtn) { collBtn.textContent = "▲"; collBtn.title = "Collapse"; }
            ["aar-fetch-zone", "aar-refetch-row"].forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.style.display = "none";
            });
            if (!document.getElementById("aar-del-btn")) {
                const topRight = document.querySelector(".aar-topbar-right");
                if (topRight) {
                    const db = document.createElement("button");
                    db.className = "aar-del-btn"; db.id = "aar-del-btn"; db.title = "Delete saved report"; db.textContent = "🗑";
                    topRight.appendChild(db);
                    db.addEventListener("click", () => {
                        if (!confirm("Delete this saved report?")) return;
                        const all = store.get(AAR_KEY, {});
                        delete all[saveKey];
                        store.set(AAR_KEY, all);
                        document.getElementById(AAR_SECTION_ID)?.remove();
                        ensureAARSection();
                    });
                }
            }
            const topLeft = document.querySelector(".aar-topbar-left");
            if (topLeft && !topLeft.querySelector(".aar-saved-stamp")) {
                const stamp = document.createElement("span");
                stamp.className = "aar-saved-stamp";
                stamp.textContent = "✔ Report saved";
                topLeft.appendChild(stamp);
            }
            setAARStatus(`✔ ${data.members.length} members parsed and saved.`, "success", 4000);
        } catch (err) {
            setAARStatus(`✘ ${err.message}`, "error");
        } finally {
            disableFetchBtns(false);
        }
    }

            if (resultText === "WINNER" || resultClass.includes("winner")) result = "won";
            if (resultText === "LOSER" || resultClass.includes("loser")) result = "lost";
            wars.push({
                rankId,
                result
            });
        });
        const totalWars = wars.length;
        const warsWon = wars.filter(w => w.result === "won").length;
        const warsLost = wars.filter(w => w.result === "lost").length;
        const winRate = totalWars ? ((warsWon / totalWars) * 100) : 0;
        let currentStreakType = "";
        let currentStreak = 0;
        let bestWinStreak = 0;
        let runningWinStreak = 0;
        wars.forEach((w, idx) => {
            if (idx === 0 && (w.result === "won" || w.result === "lost")) {
                currentStreakType = w.result === "won" ? "W" : "L";
            }
            if (idx === 0 || (currentStreak && ((currentStreakType === "W" && w.result === "won") || (currentStreakType === "L" && w.result === "lost")))) {
                if (w.result === "won" || w.result === "lost") currentStreak++;
            }
            if (w.result === "won") {
                runningWinStreak++;
                bestWinStreak = Math.max(bestWinStreak, runningWinStreak);
            } else if (w.result === "lost") {
                runningWinStreak = 0;
            }
        });
        const scanned = store.get(FW_STATS_KEY, {});
        scanned[factionId] = {
            factionId,
            totalWars,
            warsWon,
            warsLost,
            winRate,
            currentStreak: currentStreak ? `${currentStreakType}${currentStreak}` : "-",
            bestWinStreak: bestWinStreak || 0,
            avgRespect: null,
            avgScore: null,
            unknownWars: Math.max(0, totalWars - warsWon - warsLost),
            scannedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        store.set(FW_STATS_KEY, scanned);
        return scanned[factionId];
    }
    function getFactionWarfareStatsFallback() {
        const allAAR = store.get(AAR_KEY, {});
        const reports = Object.values(allAAR || {}).filter(r => r && r.members && r.members.length);
        const orderedReports = [...reports].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.savedAt || 0) - new Date(a.savedAt || 0));
        const totalWars = reports.length;
        const warsWon = reports.filter(r =>
            String(r.winner || "").trim().toLowerCase() === String(r.ourFaction || "").trim().toLowerCase()
        ).length;
        const warsLost = Math.max(0, totalWars - warsWon);
        const winRate = totalWars ? ((warsWon / totalWars) * 100) : 0;
        const respectValues = reports.map(r => parseFloat(String(r.respectGained || "").replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""))).filter(Boolean);
        const scoreValues = reports.map(r => parseFloat(String(r.ourScore || "").replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""))).filter(Boolean);
        let currentStreakType = "";
        let currentStreak = 0;
        let bestWinStreak = 0;
        let runningWinStreak = 0;
        orderedReports.forEach((r, idx) => {
            const won = String(r.winner || "").trim().toLowerCase() === String(r.ourFaction || "").trim().toLowerCase();
            const result = won ? "won" : "lost";
            if (idx === 0) currentStreakType = won ? "W" : "L";
            if (idx === 0 || (currentStreak && ((currentStreakType === "W" && won) || (currentStreakType === "L" && !won)))) {
                currentStreak++;
            }
            if (won) {
                runningWinStreak++;
                bestWinStreak = Math.max(bestWinStreak, runningWinStreak);
            } else {
                runningWinStreak = 0;
            }
        });
        return {
            totalWars,
            warsWon,
            warsLost,
            winRate,
            currentStreak: currentStreak ? `${currentStreakType}${currentStreak}` : "-",
            bestWinStreak: bestWinStreak || 0,
            avgRespect: respectValues.length ? respectValues.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / respectValues.length : null,
            avgScore: scoreValues.length ? scoreValues.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / scoreValues.length : null,
            unknownWars: 0,
            scannedAt: null,
            fallback: true
        };
    }
