    function getFactionWarfareStatsFallback() {
        const allAAR = store.get(AAR_KEY, {});
        const reports = Object.values(allAAR || {}).filter(r => r && r.members && r.members.length);
        const orderedReports = [...reports].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.savedAt || 0) - new Date(a.savedAt || 0));
        const totalWars = reports.length;
        const warsWon = reports.filter(r =>
            String(r.winner || "").trim().toLowerCase() === String(r.ourFaction || "").trim().toLowerCase()
        ).length;
        const warsLost = Math.max(0, totalWars - warsWon);
        const winRate = totalWars ? ((warsWon / totalWars) * 100) : 0;
        const respectValues = reports.map(r => parseFloat(String(r.respectGained || "").replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""))).filter(Boolean);
        const scoreValues = reports.map(r => parseFloat(String(r.ourScore || "").replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""))).filter(Boolean);
        let currentStreakType = "";
        let currentStreak = 0;
        let bestWinStreak = 0;
        let runningWinStreak = 0;
        orderedReports.forEach((r, idx) => {
            const won = String(r.winner || "").trim().toLowerCase() === String(r.ourFaction || "").trim().toLowerCase();
            const result = won ? "won" : "lost";
            if (idx === 0) currentStreakType = won ? "W" : "L";
            if (idx === 0 || (currentStreak && ((currentStreakType === "W" && won) || (currentStreakType === "L" && !won)))) {
                currentStreak++;
            }
            if (won) {
                runningWinStreak++;
                bestWinStreak = Math.max(bestWinStreak, runningWinStreak);
            } else {
                runningWinStreak = 0;
            }
        });
        return {
            totalWars,
            warsWon,
            warsLost,
            winRate,
            currentStreak: currentStreak ? `${currentStreakType}${currentStreak}` : "-",
            bestWinStreak: bestWinStreak || 0,
            avgRespect: respectValues.length ? respectValues.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / respectValues.length : null,
            avgScore: scoreValues.length ? scoreValues.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / scoreValues.length : null,
            unknownWars: 0,
            scannedAt: null,
            fallback: true
        };
    }

    function setOutsideHitsForWar(rankId, memberKey, value) {
        const db = store.get(STORAGE_KEY, { wars: {} });
        const targetRank = String(rankId || "");
        const cleanValue = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(value) || 0));
        let changed = false;
        Object.entries(db.wars || {}).forEach(([warKey, war]) => {
            if (!war || String(war.rankId || "") !== targetRank || !Array.isArray(war.members)) return;
            const member = war.members.find(item => {
                const key = item.playerId || String(item.name || "").toLowerCase();
                return String(key) === String(memberKey);
            });
            if (!member) return;
            member.outsideHits = cleanValue;
            member.outsideHitsSource = "manual";
            war.totalOutsideHits = war.members.reduce(
                (sum, item) => sum + Number(item.outsideHits || 0),
                0
            );
            war.outsideHitsUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            db.wars[warKey] = war;
            changed = true;
        });
        if (changed) {
            store.set(STORAGE_KEY, db);
            lastDataHash = "";
        }
        return changed;
    }
    function memberAttackIntelForWar(war, member) {
        const id = String(
            member?.playerId ||
            member?.id ||
            ""
        );
        const attackIntel = war?.attackIntel || {};
        const hasApiScan = Boolean(
            attackIntel.scannedAt &&
            attackIntel.attackHistoryAvailable &&
            Number(attackIntel.attackRecordsScanned || 0) > 0
        );
        let outsideHits = Number(member?.outsideHits || 0);
        let bleedScore = Number(member?.bleedScore || 0);
        if (hasApiScan && id) {
            if (
                attackIntel.outsideByMember &&
                Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                    attackIntel.outsideByMember,
                    id
                )
            ) {
                outsideHits = Number(
                    attackIntel.outsideByMember[id] || 0
                );
            } else if (attackIntel.outsideByMember) {
                outsideHits = 0;
            }
            if (
                attackIntel.bleedByMember &&
                Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                    attackIntel.bleedByMember,
                    id
                )
            ) {
                bleedScore = Number(
                    attackIntel.bleedByMember[id] || 0
                );
            } else if (attackIntel.bleedByMember) {
                bleedScore = 0;
            }
        }
        if (member?.outsideHitsSource === "manual") {
            outsideHits = Number(member.outsideHits || 0);
        }
        if (member?.bleedSource === "manual") {
            bleedScore = Number(member.bleedScore || 0);
        }
        return {
            outsideHits,
            bleedScore,
            hasScan:
                hasApiScan ||
                member?.outsideHitsSource === "api" ||
                member?.outsideHitsSource === "manual" ||
                member?.bleedSource === "api" ||
                member?.bleedSource === "manual"
        };
    }
    function setBleedScoreForWar(rankId, memberKey, value) {

                !war ||
                String(war.rankId || "") !== targetRank ||

                return;
            }

            const member = war.members.find(item => {
                const key =
                    item.playerId ||
                    String(item.name || "").toLowerCase();

                return String(key) === String(memberKey);
            });

            if (!member) return;

            member.bleedScore = cleanValue;
            member.bleedSource = "manual";

            war.totalBleedScore = war.members.reduce(
                (sum, item) =>
                    sum + Number(item.bleedScore || 0),
                0
            );

            war.bleedUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            db.wars[warKey] = war;
            changed = true;
        });

        if (changed) {
            store.set(STORAGE_KEY, db);
            lastDataHash = "";
        }

        return changed;
    }

    function setOutsideHitsForWar(rankId, memberKey, value) {
        const db = store.get(STORAGE_KEY, { wars: {} });
        const targetRank = String(rankId || "");
        const cleanValue = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(value) || 0));
        let changed = false;
        Object.entries(db.wars || {}).forEach(([warKey, war]) => {
            if (!war || String(war.rankId || "") !== targetRank || !Array.isArray(war.members)) return;
            const member = war.members.find(item => {
                const key = item.playerId || String(item.name || "").toLowerCase();
                return String(key) === String(memberKey);
            });
            if (!member) return;
            member.outsideHits = cleanValue;
            member.outsideHitsSource = "manual";
            war.totalOutsideHits = war.members.reduce(
                (sum, item) => sum + Number(item.outsideHits || 0),
                0
            );
            war.outsideHitsUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            db.wars[warKey] = war;
            changed = true;
        });
        if (changed) {
            store.set(STORAGE_KEY, db);
            lastDataHash = "";
        }
        return changed;

    function memberAttackIntelForWar(war, member) {
        const id = String(
            member?.playerId ||
            member?.id ||
            ""
        );
        const attackIntel = war?.attackIntel || {};
        const hasApiScan = Boolean(
            attackIntel.scannedAt &&
            attackIntel.attackHistoryAvailable &&
            Number(attackIntel.attackRecordsScanned || 0) > 0
        );
        let outsideHits = Number(member?.outsideHits || 0);
        let bleedScore = Number(member?.bleedScore || 0);
        if (hasApiScan && id) {
            if (
                attackIntel.outsideByMember &&
                Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                    attackIntel.outsideByMember,
                    id
                )
            ) {
                outsideHits = Number(
                    attackIntel.outsideByMember[id] || 0
                );
            } else if (attackIntel.outsideByMember) {
                outsideHits = 0;
            }
            if (
                attackIntel.bleedByMember &&
                Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                    attackIntel.bleedByMember,
                    id
                )
            ) {
                bleedScore = Number(
                    attackIntel.bleedByMember[id] || 0
                );
            } else if (attackIntel.bleedByMember) {
                bleedScore = 0;
            }
        }
        if (member?.outsideHitsSource === "manual") {
            outsideHits = Number(member.outsideHits || 0);
        }
        if (member?.bleedSource === "manual") {
            bleedScore = Number(member.bleedScore || 0);
        }
        return {
            outsideHits,
            bleedScore,
            hasScan:
                hasApiScan ||
                member?.outsideHitsSource === "api" ||
                member?.outsideHitsSource === "manual" ||
                member?.bleedSource === "api" ||
                member?.bleedSource === "manual"
        };
    }

    function memberAttackIntelForWar(war, member) {
        const id = String(
            member?.playerId ||
            member?.id ||
            ""
        );
        const attackIntel = war?.attackIntel || {};
        const hasApiScan = Boolean(
            attackIntel.scannedAt &&
            attackIntel.attackHistoryAvailable &&
            Number(attackIntel.attackRecordsScanned || 0) > 0
        );
        let outsideHits = Number(member?.outsideHits || 0);
        let bleedScore = Number(member?.bleedScore || 0);
        if (hasApiScan && id) {
            if (
                attackIntel.outsideByMember &&
                Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                    attackIntel.outsideByMember,
                    id
                )
            ) {
                outsideHits = Number(
                    attackIntel.outsideByMember[id] || 0
                );
            } else if (attackIntel.outsideByMember) {
                outsideHits = 0;
            }
            if (
                attackIntel.bleedByMember &&
                Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                    attackIntel.bleedByMember,
                    id
                )
            ) {
                bleedScore = Number(
                    attackIntel.bleedByMember[id] || 0
                );
            } else if (attackIntel.bleedByMember) {
                bleedScore = 0;
            }
        }
        if (member?.outsideHitsSource === "manual") {
            outsideHits = Number(member.outsideHits || 0);
        }
        if (member?.bleedSource === "manual") {
            bleedScore = Number(member.bleedScore || 0);
        }
        return {
            outsideHits,
            bleedScore,
            hasScan:
                hasApiScan ||
                member?.outsideHitsSource === "api" ||
                member?.outsideHitsSource === "manual" ||
                member?.bleedSource === "api" ||
                member?.bleedSource === "manual"
        };
    }
    function setBleedScoreForWar(rankId, memberKey, value) {
        const db = store.get(STORAGE_KEY, { wars: {} });
        const targetRank = String(rankId || "");
        const cleanValue = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(value) || 0));
        let changed = false;

        Object.entries(db.wars || {}).forEach(([warKey, war]) => {
            if (
                !war ||
                String(war.rankId || "") !== targetRank ||
                !Array.isArray(war.members)
            ) {
                return;
            }

            const member = war.members.find(item => {
                const key =
                    item.playerId ||
                    String(item.name || "").toLowerCase();

                return String(key) === String(memberKey);
            });

            if (!member) return;

            member.bleedScore = cleanValue;
            member.bleedSource = "manual";

            war.totalBleedScore = war.members.reduce(
                (sum, item) =>
                    sum + Number(item.bleedScore || 0),
                0
            );

            war.bleedUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            db.wars[warKey] = war;
            changed = true;
        });

        if (changed) {
            store.set(STORAGE_KEY, db);
            lastDataHash = "";
        }

        return changed;
    }

    function aggregateData() {
        const db = store.get(STORAGE_KEY, { wars: {} });
        const hidden = store.get(HIDDEN_KEY, {});
        const sort = store.get(SORT_KEY, { key: "hits", dir: -1 });
        const advExempt = store.get(ADV_EXEMPT_KEY, {});
        const aarDateMap = {};
        const allAAR = store.get(AAR_KEY, {});
        Object.entries(allAAR).forEach(([key, aar]) => {
            const rankId = parseInt(key.split("-")[0], 10);
            if (!rankId || !aar.sharedDate) return;
            try {
                const d = new Date(aar.sharedDate.replace(/^Shared on\s*/i, ""));
                if (!isNaN(d)) aarDateMap[rankId] = d.toISOString();
            } catch(e) {}
        });
        const factionWars = Object.values(db.wars).filter(w =>
            w.members &&
            w.members.length > 0
        );
        const newestFirst = [...factionWars].sort((a, b) => {
            if (a.rankId && b.rankId) return b.rankId - a.rankId;
            return new Date(b.savedAt || 0) - new Date(a.savedAt || 0);
        });
        const latestWar = newestFirst[0] || null;
        const latestWarKey = latestWar
            ? String(
                latestWar.rankId ||
                latestWar.firstSavedAt ||
                latestWar.savedAt ||
                ""
            )
            : "";
        const memberMap = new Map();
        factionWars.forEach(war => {
            const totalWarHits = Number(war.totalHits || war.members.reduce((sum, m) => sum + Number(m.attacks || 0), 0));
            const activeCount = war.members.filter(m => Number(m.attacks || 0) > 0).length || war.members.length || 1;
            const factionAvgHits = Number(war.avgHits || (totalWarHits / activeCount));
            war.members.forEach((m, idx) => {
                const mKey = m.playerId || m.name.toLowerCase();
                if (!memberMap.has(mKey)) memberMap.set(mKey, {
                    key: mKey, id: m.playerId, name: m.name, advancementExempt: !!advExempt[mKey],
                    wars: 0, hits: 0, outsideHits: 0, outsideScannedWars: 0, bleedScore: 0, score: 0, zeros: 0, activeWars: 0,
                    lastHits: 0, lastScore: 0, inLatest: false,
                    consecutiveZeros: 0, lastZeroDate: null, lastZeroWarId: null,
                    currentHitStreak: 0, bestHitStreak: 0, missedWars: 0, lastMissedWarId: null,
                    top5Finishes: 0, placementTotal: 0, placementWars: 0,
                    bestHits: 0, bestHitsWarId: null, bestScore: 0, bestScoreWarId: null,
                    hitShares: [], carryValues: [], entries: []
                });
                const r = memberMap.get(mKey);
                const att = Number(m.attacks || 0);
                const attackIntel = memberAttackIntelForWar(war, m);
                const outsideHits = Number(attackIntel.outsideHits || 0);
                const bleedScore = Number(attackIntel.bleedScore || 0);
                const score = Number(m.score || 0);
                const placement = Number(m.placement || idx + 1);
                const hitShare = totalWarHits ? (att / totalWarHits) * 100 : 0;
                const carryIndex = factionAvgHits ? att / factionAvgHits : 0;
                const warRef = war.rankId || "Manual";
                r.wars++;
                r.hits += att;
                r.outsideHits += outsideHits;
                r.bleedScore += bleedScore;
                if (attackIntel.hasScan) {
                    r.outsideScannedWars += 1;
                }
                r.score += score;
                r.hitShares.push(hitShare);
                r.carryValues.push(carryIndex);
                r.placementTotal += placement;
                r.placementWars++;
                if (placement <= 5 && att > 0) r.top5Finishes++;
                if (att === 0) r.zeros++;
                else r.activeWars++;
                if (att > r.bestHits) { r.bestHits = att; r.bestHitsWarId = warRef; }
                if (score > r.bestScore) { r.bestScore = score; r.bestScoreWarId = warRef; }
                const currentWarKey = String(
                    war.rankId ||
                    war.firstSavedAt ||
                    war.savedAt ||
                    ""
                );

                if (currentWarKey && currentWarKey === latestWarKey) {
                    r.lastHits = att;
                    r.lastScore = score;
                    r.inLatest = true;
                }
                r.entries.push({
                    rankId: warRef,
                    warDate: war.warDate || (war.rankId && aarDateMap[war.rankId]) || war.savedAt,
                    attacks: att,
                    outsideHits,
                    bleedScore,
                    memberKey: mKey,
                    score,
                    placement,
                    hitShare,
                    carryIndex,
                    totalWarHits
                });
            });
        });
        memberMap.forEach(r => {
            let zeroStreak = 0;
            let zeroBroken = false;

                hasApiScan ||
                member?.outsideHitsSource === "api" ||
                member?.outsideHitsSource === "manual" ||
                member?.bleedSource === "api" ||
                member?.bleedSource === "manual"
        };
    }
    function setBleedScoreForWar(rankId, memberKey, value) {
        const db = store.get(STORAGE_KEY, { wars: {} });
        const targetRank = String(rankId || "");
        const cleanValue = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(value) || 0));
        let changed = false;

        Object.entries(db.wars || {}).forEach(([warKey, war]) => {
            if (
                !war ||
                String(war.rankId || "") !== targetRank ||
                !Array.isArray(war.members)
            ) {
                return;
            }

            const member = war.members.find(item => {
                const key =
                    item.playerId ||
                    String(item.name || "").toLowerCase();

                return String(key) === String(memberKey);
            });

            if (!member) return;

            member.bleedScore = cleanValue;
            member.bleedSource = "manual";

            war.totalBleedScore = war.members.reduce(
                (sum, item) =>
                    sum + Number(item.bleedScore || 0),
                0
            );

            war.bleedUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            db.wars[warKey] = war;
            changed = true;
        });

        if (changed) {
            store.set(STORAGE_KEY, db);
            lastDataHash = "";
        }

        return changed;
    }

    function aggregateData() {
        const db = store.get(STORAGE_KEY, { wars: {} });
        const hidden = store.get(HIDDEN_KEY, {});
        const sort = store.get(SORT_KEY, { key: "hits", dir: -1 });
        const advExempt = store.get(ADV_EXEMPT_KEY, {});
        const aarDateMap = {};
        const allAAR = store.get(AAR_KEY, {});
        Object.entries(allAAR).forEach(([key, aar]) => {
            const rankId = parseInt(key.split("-")[0], 10);
            if (!rankId || !aar.sharedDate) return;
            try {
                const d = new Date(aar.sharedDate.replace(/^Shared on\s*/i, ""));
                if (!isNaN(d)) aarDateMap[rankId] = d.toISOString();
            } catch(e) {}
        });
        const factionWars = Object.values(db.wars).filter(w =>
            w.members &&
            w.members.length > 0
        );
        const newestFirst = [...factionWars].sort((a, b) => {
            if (a.rankId && b.rankId) return b.rankId - a.rankId;
            return new Date(b.savedAt || 0) - new Date(a.savedAt || 0);
        });
        const latestWar = newestFirst[0] || null;
        const latestWarKey = latestWar
            ? String(
                latestWar.rankId ||
                latestWar.firstSavedAt ||
                latestWar.savedAt ||
                ""
            )
            : "";
        const memberMap = new Map();
        factionWars.forEach(war => {
            const totalWarHits = Number(war.totalHits || war.members.reduce((sum, m) => sum + Number(m.attacks || 0), 0));
            const activeCount = war.members.filter(m => Number(m.attacks || 0) > 0).length || war.members.length || 1;
            const factionAvgHits = Number(war.avgHits || (totalWarHits / activeCount));
            war.members.forEach((m, idx) => {
                const mKey = m.playerId || m.name.toLowerCase();
                if (!memberMap.has(mKey)) memberMap.set(mKey, {
                    key: mKey, id: m.playerId, name: m.name, advancementExempt: !!advExempt[mKey],
                    wars: 0, hits: 0, outsideHits: 0, outsideScannedWars: 0, bleedScore: 0, score: 0, zeros: 0, activeWars: 0,
                    lastHits: 0, lastScore: 0, inLatest: false,

                    currentHitStreak: 0, bestHitStreak: 0, missedWars: 0, lastMissedWarId: null,
                    top5Finishes: 0, placementTotal: 0, placementWars: 0,
                    bestHits: 0, bestHitsWarId: null, bestScore: 0, bestScoreWarId: null,
                    hitShares: [], carryValues: [], entries: []
                });
                const r = memberMap.get(mKey);
                const att = Number(m.attacks || 0);
                const attackIntel = memberAttackIntelForWar(war, m);
                const outsideHits = Number(attackIntel.outsideHits || 0);
                const bleedScore = Number(attackIntel.bleedScore || 0);
                const score = Number(m.score || 0);
                const placement = Number(m.placement || idx + 1);
                const hitShare = totalWarHits ? (att / totalWarHits) * 100 : 0;
                const carryIndex = factionAvgHits ? att / factionAvgHits : 0;
                const warRef = war.rankId || "Manual";
                r.wars++;
                r.hits += att;
                r.outsideHits += outsideHits;
                r.bleedScore += bleedScore;
                if (attackIntel.hasScan) {
                    r.outsideScannedWars += 1;
                }
                r.score += score;
                r.hitShares.push(hitShare);
                r.carryValues.push(carryIndex);
                r.placementTotal += placement;
                r.placementWars++;
                if (placement <= 5 && att > 0) r.top5Finishes++;
                if (att === 0) r.zeros++;
                else r.activeWars++;
                if (att > r.bestHits) { r.bestHits = att; r.bestHitsWarId = warRef; }
                if (score > r.bestScore) { r.bestScore = score; r.bestScoreWarId = warRef; }
                const currentWarKey = String(
                    war.rankId ||
                    war.firstSavedAt ||
                    war.savedAt ||
                    ""
                );

                if (currentWarKey && currentWarKey === latestWarKey) {
                    r.lastHits = att;
                    r.lastScore = score;
                    r.inLatest = true;
                }
                r.entries.push({
                    rankId: warRef,
                    warDate: war.warDate || (war.rankId && aarDateMap[war.rankId]) || war.savedAt,
                    attacks: att,
                    outsideHits,
                    bleedScore,
                    memberKey: mKey,
                    score,
                    placement,
                    hitShare,
                    carryIndex,
                    totalWarHits
                });
            });
        });

            let zeroBroken = false;
            let hitStreak = 0;
            let hitBroken = false;

        modal.querySelectorAll("[data-outside-rank][data-outside-member]").forEach(input => {
            const saveOutsideHits = () => {
                const value = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(input.value) || 0));
                input.value = String(value);
                if (!setOutsideHitsForWar(
                    input.dataset.outsideRank,
                    input.dataset.outsideMember,
                    value
                )) {
                    return;

                    modal.querySelector(".fw-modal-tab.active")?.dataset.tab || "history";

                    item => String(item.key) === String(member.key)
                );
                modal.remove();
                lastDataHash = "";
                render();
                if (refreshed) {
                    showMemberHistory(refreshed);
                    const nextModal = document.getElementById("fw-member-modal");
                    nextModal?.querySelectorAll(".fw-modal-tab").forEach(button => {
                        if (button.dataset.tab === activeTab) button.click();
                    });
                }
            };
            input.addEventListener("change", saveOutsideHits);
            input.addEventListener("keydown", event => {

                    event.preventDefault();
                    input.blur();

        });

    function markSavedWarViewLinks() {
        const db = store.get(STORAGE_KEY, { wars: {} });
        const savedRankIds = new Set(
            Object.values(db.wars || {})
                .filter(war => war && Array.isArray(war.members) && war.members.length > 0)
                .map(war => String(war.rankId || ""))
                .filter(Boolean)
        );
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="war.php?step=rankreport"][href*="rankID="]').forEach(link => {
            const href = link.getAttribute("href") || "";
            const rankId = href.match(/rankID=(\d+)/i)?.[1] || "";
            const isSaved = Boolean(rankId && savedRankIds.has(rankId));
            link.classList.toggle("fw-war-scanned-link", isSaved);
            link.dataset.fwWarScanned = isSaved ? "1" : "0";
            if (isSaved) {
                if (!link.dataset.fwOriginalText) {
                    link.dataset.fwOriginalText = (link.textContent || "View").trim() || "View";
                }
                link.textContent = `✓ ${link.dataset.fwOriginalText}`;
                link.setAttribute("aria-label", `Scanned war ${rankId}. View report`);
            } else if (link.dataset.fwOriginalText) {
                link.textContent = link.dataset.fwOriginalText;
                link.removeAttribute("aria-label");
                delete link.dataset.fwOriginalText;
            }
        });
    }

    function isWarLedgerRateLimit(response, data) {
        const message = String(
            data?.error?.error ||

            data?.message ||
            ""
        ).toLowerCase();

        const code = Number(data?.error?.code || data?.error_code || 0);

        return (
            Number(response?.status || 0) === 429 ||

            /too many requests|rate.?limit/.test(message)
        );

    function markSavedWarViewLinks() {
        const db = store.get(STORAGE_KEY, { wars: {} });
        const savedRankIds = new Set(
            Object.values(db.wars || {})
                .filter(war => war && Array.isArray(war.members) && war.members.length > 0)
                .map(war => String(war.rankId || ""))
                .filter(Boolean)
        );
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="war.php?step=rankreport"][href*="rankID="]').forEach(link => {
            const href = link.getAttribute("href") || "";
            const rankId = href.match(/rankID=(\d+)/i)?.[1] || "";
            const isSaved = Boolean(rankId && savedRankIds.has(rankId));
            link.classList.toggle("fw-war-scanned-link", isSaved);
            link.dataset.fwWarScanned = isSaved ? "1" : "0";
            if (isSaved) {
                if (!link.dataset.fwOriginalText) {
                    link.dataset.fwOriginalText = (link.textContent || "View").trim() || "View";
                }
                link.textContent = `✓ ${link.dataset.fwOriginalText}`;
                link.setAttribute("aria-label", `Scanned war ${rankId}. View report`);
            } else if (link.dataset.fwOriginalText) {
                link.textContent = link.dataset.fwOriginalText;
                link.removeAttribute("aria-label");
                delete link.dataset.fwOriginalText;
            }
        });
    }
    function getWarLedgerApiKey() {
        return String(context?.settings?.api?.key || "").trim();
    }
    let warLedgerLastApiRequestAt = 0;
    let warLedgerApiQueue = Promise.resolve();

    function warLedgerSleep(ms) {
        return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
    }

    function warLedgerResponseHeader(responseHeaders, name) {
        const target = String(name || "").toLowerCase();

        return String(responseHeaders || "")
            .split(/\r?\n/)
            .map(line => line.split(":"))
            .find(parts => String(parts.shift() || "").trim().toLowerCase() === target)
            ?.join(":")
            ?.trim() || "";
    }

    function isWarLedgerRateLimit(response, data) {
        const message = String(
            data?.error?.error ||
            data?.error?.message ||
            data?.message ||
            ""
        ).toLowerCase();

        const code = Number(data?.error?.code || data?.error_code || 0);

        return (
            Number(response?.status || 0) === 429 ||
            code === 5 ||
            /too many requests|rate.?limit/.test(message)
        );
    }

    function warLedgerResponseHeader(responseHeaders, name) {
        const target = String(name || "").toLowerCase();

        return String(responseHeaders || "")
            .split(/\r?\n/)
            .map(line => line.split(":"))
            .find(parts => String(parts.shift() || "").trim().toLowerCase() === target)
            ?.join(":")
            ?.trim() || "";
    }

    function isWarLedgerRateLimit(response, data) {
        const message = String(
            data?.error?.error ||
            data?.error?.message ||
            data?.message ||
            ""
        ).toLowerCase();

        const code = Number(data?.error?.code || data?.error_code || 0);

        return (
            Number(response?.status || 0) === 429 ||
            code === 5 ||
            /too many requests|rate.?limit/.test(message)
        );
    }

    async function warLedgerRequestJSONNow(url, options = {}) {
        const maxRetries = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxRetries ?? 6));
        const minGapMs = Math.max(250, Number(options.minGapMs ?? 900));

        for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
            const sinceLast = Date.now() - warLedgerLastApiRequestAt;

            if (sinceLast < minGapMs) {
                await warLedgerSleep(minGapMs - sinceLast);
            }

            warLedgerLastApiRequestAt = Date.now();

            const response = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                    method: "GET",
                    url,
                    timeout: 30000,
                    headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
                    onload: resolve,
                    onerror: () => reject(new Error("Unable to contact Torn API")),
                    ontimeout: () => reject(new Error("Torn API request timed out"))
                });
            });

            let data;

            try {
                data = JSON.parse(response.responseText || "{}");
            } catch {
                throw new Error("Invalid Torn API response");
            }

            if (!isWarLedgerRateLimit(response, data)) {
                if (data?.error) {
                    throw new Error(
                        data.error.error ||
                        data.error.message ||
                        data.error.code ||
                        "Torn API error"
                    );
                }

                return data;
            }

            if (attempt >= maxRetries) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Too Many Requests after ${maxRetries + 1} attempts`
                );
            }

            const retryAfter = Number(
                warLedgerResponseHeader(
                    response.responseHeaders,
                    "retry-after"
                )
            );

            const waitMs = retryAfter > 0
                ? retryAfter * 1000
                : Math.min(
                    12000,
                    1500 * Math.pow(1

        const code = Number(data?.error?.code || data?.error_code || 0);

        return (
            Number(response?.status || 0) === 429 ||
            code === 5 ||
            /too many requests|rate.?limit/.test(message)
        );
    }

    async function warLedgerRequestJSONNow(url, options = {}) {
        const maxRetries = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxRetries ?? 6));
        const minGapMs = Math.max(250, Number(options.minGapMs ?? 900));

        for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
            const sinceLast = Date.now() - warLedgerLastApiRequestAt;

            if (sinceLast < minGapMs) {
                await warLedgerSleep(minGapMs - sinceLast);
            }

            warLedgerLastApiRequestAt = Date.now();

            const response = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                    method: "GET",
                    url,
                    timeout: 30000,
                    headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
                    onload: resolve,
                    onerror: () => reject(new Error("Unable to contact Torn API")),
                    ontimeout: () => reject(new Error("Torn API request timed out"))
                });
            });

            let data;

            try {
                data = JSON.parse(response.responseText || "{}");
            } catch {
                throw new Error("Invalid Torn API response");
            }

            if (!isWarLedgerRateLimit(response, data)) {
                if (data?.error) {
                    throw new Error(
                        data.error.error ||
                        data.error.message ||
                        data.error.code ||
                        "Torn API error"
                    );
                }

                return data;
            }

            if (attempt >= maxRetries) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Too Many Requests after ${maxRetries + 1} attempts`
                );
            }

            const retryAfter = Number(
                warLedgerResponseHeader(
                    response.responseHeaders,
                    "retry-after"
                )
            );

            const waitMs = retryAfter > 0
                ? retryAfter * 1000
                : Math.min(
                    12000,
                    1500 * Math.pow(1.8, attempt)
                );

            await warLedgerSleep(waitMs);
        }

        throw new Error("Torn API request failed");
    }

    function warLedgerRequestJSON(url, options = {}) {
        const queued = warLedgerApiQueue.then(
            () => warLedgerRequestJSONNow(url, options),
            () => warLedgerRequestJSO

===== store #133 @ 1299880 =====
      "Could not identify the enemy faction in this ranked war."
            );
        }

        let attackSource = "v2";
        let allAttacks = await fetchAllFactionAttacksForWar(
            apiKey,
            "",
            start,
            end
        );

        if (!allAttacks.length) {
            attackSource = "v1-fallback";
            allAttacks = await fetchLegacyFactionAttacksForWar(
                apiKey,
                start,
                end
            );
        }

        const attackHistoryAvailable = allAttacks.length > 0;

        const outsideByMember = {};
        const bleedByMember = {};
        const outsideAttackIds = [];
        const bleedAttackIds = [];

        let successfulRecords = 0;
        let ownOutgoingRecords = 0;
        let enemyIncomingRecords = 0;
        let ownVsEnemyRecords = 0;
        let unknownDirectionRecords = 0;

        allAttacks.forEach(attack => {
            if (!isSuccessfulWarLedgerAttack(attack)) return;

            successfulRecords += 1;

            const attackerFactionId =
                Number(attack.attackerFactionId || 0);
            const defenderFactionId =
                Number(attack.defenderFactionId || 0);

            const isOwnOutgoing =
                attackerFactionId === ownFactionId;

            const isEnemyIncoming =
                attackerFactionId === enemyFactionId &&
                defenderFactionId === ownFactionId;

            if (isOwnOutgoing) {
                ownOutgoingRecords += 1;

                if (defenderFactionId === enemyFactionId) {
                    ownVsEnemyRecords += 1;
                } else if (attack.attackerId) {
                    const memberId = String(attack.attackerId);

                    outsideByMember[memberId] =
                        Number(outsideByMember[memberId] || 0) + 1;

                    outsideAttackIds.push(attack.id);
                }
            }

            if (isEnemyIncoming && attack.defenderId) {
                enemyIncomingRecords += 1;

                const memberId = String(attack.defenderId);

                bleedByMember[memberId] =
                    Number(bleedByMember[memberId] || 0) + 1;

                bleedAttackIds.push(attack.id);
            }

            if (
                !isOwnOutgoing &&
                defenderFactionId !== ownFactionId
            ) {
                unknownDirectionRecords += 1;
            }
        });

        return {
            rankId: Number(rankId) || rankId,
            start,
            end,
            ownFactionId,
            ownFactionName,
            enemyFactionId,
            enemyFactionName,
            outsideByMember,
            bleedByMember,
            outsideTotal: Object.values(outsideByMember).reduce(
                (a, b) => a + Number(b || 0),
                0
            ),
            bleedTotal: Object.values(bleedByMember).reduce(
                (a, b) => a + Number(b || 0),
                0
            ),
            attackRecordsScanned: allAttacks.length,
            attackHistoryAvailable,
            attackSource,
            successfulRecords,
            ownOutgoingRecords,
            ownVsEnemyRecords,
            enemyIncomingRecords,
            unknownDirectionRecords,
            outsideAttackIds,
            bleedAttackIds,
            scannedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };
    }

    function applyCompletedWarAttackIntel(rankId, intel) {
        const db = store.get(STORAGE_KEY, { wars: {} });
        const targetRank = String(rankId || "");
        let applied = false;
        Object.entries(db.wars || {}).forEach(([warKey, war]) => {
            if (
                !war ||
                String(war.rankId || "") !== targetRank ||
                !Array.isArray(war.members)
            ) {
                return;
            }
            war.members = war.members.map(member => {
                const id = String(member.playerId || member.id || "");
                if (!id) return member;

                if (!intel.attackHistoryAvailable) {
                    return member;
                }

                return {
                    ...member,
                    outsideHits:
                        member.outsideHitsSource === "manual"
                            ? Number(member.outsideHits || 0)
                            : Number(intel.outsideByMember?.[id] || 0),
                    outsideHitsSource:
                        member.outsideHitsSource === "manual"
                            ? "manual"
                            : "api",
                    bleedScore:
                        member.bleedSource === "manual"
                            ? Number(member.bleedScore || 0)
                            : Number(intel.bleedByMember?.[id] || 0),
                    bleedSource:
                        member.bleedSource === "manual"
                            ? "manual"
                            : "api"
                };
            });
            war.totalOutsideHits = war.members.reduce(
                (sum, member) => sum + Number(member.outsideHits || 0),
                0
            );
            war.totalBleedScore = war.members.reduce(
                (sum, member) => sum + Number(member.bleedScore || 0),
                0
            );
            war.attackIntel = {
                start: intel.start,
                end: intel.end,
                ownFactionId: intel.ownFactionId,
                ownFactionName: intel.ownFactionName,
                enemyFactionId: intel.enemyFactionId,
                enemyFactionName: intel.enemyFactionName,
                attackRecordsScanned: Number(intel.attackRecordsScanned || 0),
                attackHistoryAvailable: Boolean(intel.attackHistoryAvailable),
                attackSource: String(intel.attackSource || ""),
                successfulRecords: Number(intel.successfulRecords || 0),
                ownOutgoingRecords: Number(intel.ownOutgoingRecords || 0),
                ownVsEnemyRecords: Number(intel.ownVsEnemyRecords || 0),
                enemyIncomingRecords: Number(intel.enemyIncomingRecords || 0),
                unknownDirectionRecords: Number(intel.unknownDirectionRecords || 0),
                outsideTotal: intel.outsideTotal,
                bleedTotal: intel.bleedTotal,
                outsideByMember: {
                    ...(intel.outsideByMember || {})
                },
                bleedByMember: {
                    ...(intel.bleedByMember || {})
                },
                scannedAt: intel.scannedAt
            };
            war.savedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            db.wars[warKey] = war;
            applied = true;
        });
        if (applied) {
            store.set(STORAGE_KEY, db);
            lastDataHash = "";
        }
        return applied;
    }

                    ...previous,
                    selectedFactionKey: "all-scans",
                    selectedFactionName: previous.selectedFactionName && previous.selectedFactionName !== fName
                        ? `${previous.selectedFactionName} + ${fName}`
                        : fName,
                    members: mergedMembers,
                    totalHits: mergedTotalHits,
                    totalOutsideHits: mergedMembers.reduce(
                        (sum, member) => sum + Number(member.outsideHits || 0),
                        0
                    ),
                    totalBleedScore: mergedMembers.reduce(
                        (sum, member) => sum + Number(member.bleedScore || 0),
                        0
                    ),
                    totalScore: mergedTotalScore,
                    activeMembers: mergedActiveMembers,
                    avgHits: mergedAvgHits,
                    scanSides: Array.from(new Set([...(previous.scanSides || []), fKey].filter(Boolean))),
                    rankId: parseInt(warId, 10) || 0,
                    rosterSource: rosterInfo?.source || "page",
                    rosterMemberCount: mergedMembers.length,
                    warStart: rosterInfo?.start || previous.warStart || 0,
                    warEnd: rosterInfo?.end || previous.warEnd || 0,
                    warDate: warDate || previous.warDate || null,
                    firstSavedAt: previous.firstSavedAt || previous.savedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
                    savedAt: new Date().toISOString()
                };
                db.selectedFactionKey = "all-scans";
                store.set(STORAGE_KEY, db);
                let attackIntel = null;
                let attackIntelError = "";
                try {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.innerHTML = "<span>LOGS…</span>";
                    btn.title = "Scanning completed-war faction attack logs…";
                    attackIntel = await scanCompletedWarAttackIntel(warId, rosterInfo);
                    applyCompletedWarAttackIntel(warId, attackIntel);
                } catch (error) {
                    attackIntelError = String(error?.message || error || "Attack-log scan failed");
                    console.warn("[SakaLuX War Performance] Completed-war attack scan failed:", error);
                } finally {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                }
                const refreshedDb = store.get(STORAGE_KEY, { wars: {} });
                const savedCount = Object.values(refreshedDb.wars || {}).filter(w => w && w.members && w.members.length).length;
                btn.innerHTML = `<span>✔ ${savedCount}</span>`;
                btn.style.background = attackIntelError
                    ? "var(--sakalux-orange)"
                    : "var(--sakalux-accent)";
                btn.title = attackIntel
                    ? (
                        attackIntel.attackHistoryAvailable
                            ? `Saved War #${warId} - ${mergedMembers.length} historical members - ${attackIntel.attackSource} attack logs - ${attackIntel.attackRecordsScanned} records - Outside ${attackIntel.outsideTotal} - Bleed ${attackIntel.bleedTotal}`
                            : `Saved War #${warId} - ${mergedMembers.length} historical members - historical attack logs unavailable from Torn - enter Outside/Bleed manually if required`
                    )
                    : `Saved War #${warId} - ${mergedMembers.length} historical members - Attack logs: ${attackIntelError || "not scanned"}`;
                markSavedWarViewLinks();
                renderRankReportAttackIntel();
                lastDataHash = ""; render();
            };
            header.appendChild(btn);
        });
    }

function tlDayKey(ts) { const d=new Date(ts); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`; }
function tlFmtDate(ts) { const d=new Date(ts); return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{day:"numeric",month:"short",year:"numeric"})+" "+d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined,{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"}); }

function schLoad() {
    try {
        let raw=localStorage.getItem(CFG.scheduleKey);
        if(raw===null){
            const migrated=localStorage.getItem(CFG.scheduleMigrationKey)==="1";
            let entries=[];
            if(!migrated){
                try {
                    const legacy=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CFG.legacyScheduleKey)||'{"entries":[]}');
                    entries=Array.isArray(legacy?.entries)?legacy.entries:[];
                } catch {}
                localStorage.setItem(CFG.scheduleMigrationKey,"1");
            }
            const fresh={entries};
            localStorage.setItem(CFG.scheduleKey,JSON.stringify(fresh));
            raw=JSON.stringify(fresh);
        }
        const parsed=JSON.parse(raw||'{"entries":[]}');
        return {entries:Array.isArray(parsed?.entries)?parsed.entries:[]};
    } catch {
        return {entries:[]};
    }
}
function schSave(d) {
    localStorage.setItem(CFG.scheduleMigrationKey,"1");
    localStorage.setItem(CFG.scheduleKey,JSON.stringify({
        entries:Array.isArray(d?.entries)?d.entries:[]
    }));
}
function schAdd(entry) {
    const d=schLoad();
    const now=Date.now();
    d.entries.push({
        id:`sch_${now}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7)}`,
        ts:Number(entry.ts)||now,
        name:entry.name||"",
        role:entry.role||"",
        note:entry.note||"",
        createdAt:now
    });
    schSave(d);
}
function schRemove(id) { const d=schLoad(); d.entries=d.entries.filter(e=>e.id!==id); schSave(d); }
function schClear() {
    localStorage.setItem(CFG.scheduleMigrationKey,"1");
    localStorage.setItem(CFG.scheduleKey,JSON.stringify({entries:[]}));
    localStorage.removeItem(CFG.legacyScheduleKey);
}

function updateRowBadge(row,input) {
    const delivCell=row.querySelector(".acc-body .info-wrap .delivery");if(!delivCell)return;
    const mobileLabel=delivCell.querySelector(".t-show");
    let badge=delivCell.querySelector(".fc-badge");
    if(!badge){badge=document.createElement("span");badge.className="fc-badge is-mid";}
    if(!mobileLabel){if(!delivCell.dataset.fcDesktop){delivCell.innerHTML="";delivCell.classList.add("fc-delivery-desktop");delivCell.appendChild(badge);delivCell.dataset.fcDesktop="1";}}
    else{mobileLabel.innerText="Days Left: ";mobileLabel.style.marginRight="5px";Array.from(delivCell.childNodes).forEach(n=>{if(n.nodeType===3&&n.textContent.trim())n.remove();});if(!delivCell.contains(badge))delivCell.appendChild(badge);}
    const baseStock=parseFloat(row.dataset.fcStock||"0")||0,soldDaily=parseFloat(row.dataset.fcDaily||"0")||0,added=cleanNum(input?input.value:"0"),total=baseStock+added,days=soldDaily>0?total/soldDaily:(total>0?999:0);
    badge.textContent=days>=999?"∞":days.toFixed(1);

function performGetStocked(e) {
    if(e)e.preventDefault();
    const btn=document.getElementById("fc-get-stocked-btn");
    const storage=getStorageCapacity();
    if(!storage){flashFcBtn(btn,"No Capacity","red","Stock Up",1400);alert("Could not read Storage Capacity.");return;}
    if(storage.availableSpace<=0){flashFcBtn(btn,"Warehouse Full","red","Stock Up",1400);return;}
    const items=getStockRows().map(r=>({row:r,input:r.querySelector(".quantity input"),stock:parseFloat(r.dataset.fcStock||0)||0,daily:parseFloat(r.dataset.fcDaily||0)||0})).filter(it=>it.input&&it.daily>0);
    if(!items.length){flashFcBtn(btn,"No Items","red","Stock Up",1300);return;}
    let lo=0,hi=CFG.maxSimDays,optDays=0;
    for(let i=0;i<25;i++){const mid=(lo+hi)/2;const needed=items.reduce((s,it)=>s+Math.max(0,(it.daily*mid)-it.stock),0);if(needed<=storage.availableSpace){optDays=mid;lo=mid;}else hi=mid;}
    items.forEach(it=>{const n=Math.max(0,Math.floor((it.daily*optDays)-it.stock));const v=n>0?String(n):"";if(it.input.value!==v){it.input.value=v;it.input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));it.input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change",{bubbles:true}));}});
    flashFcBtn(btn,"Stock Up","green","Stock Up",1200);
}

async function openPayCalc(li){
    if(!li)return;
    await wait(80);
    li=brResolveEmployeeRow(li)||li;
    buildPayModal();
    const ov=document.getElementById("fc-pay-overlay"),m=document.getElementById("fc-pay-modal");
    m.dataset.employeePointer=brPointer(li);m.dataset.currentRole=brGetPosition(li);m.dataset.companyName=brDetectCompany()||"";
    ov.style.display="block";m.style.display="block";
    psRestore();
    setPayHtml("fpc-tags",`<span class="fpc-pill">Reading effectiveness…</span>`);
    const stats=brGetStats(li),req=brGetReq(li,brGetRoleSet()),roleName=brGetPosition(li),pay=brGetPay(li),eff=brGetEff(li);
    const company=brDetectCompany()||"";
    const tip=await brGetEffTip(li);
    const mods=brParseTip(tip);
    setPayFld("fpc-m",stats.M);setPayFld("fpc-i",stats.I);setPayFld("fpc-e",stats.E);
    setPayFld("fpc-current-pay",pay);setPayFld("fpc-base-pay",bpGet(roleName)||0);
    setPayFld("fpc-exact-pay",parseFloat(String(pay||"").replace(/[^\d.]/g,""))||"");
    setPayFld("fpc-merits",mods.merits>0?mods.merits:0);setPayFld("fpc-settled",mods.settled>0?mods.settled:0);
    setPayFld("fpc-dir-ed",mods.dirEd>0?mods.dirEd:0);
    setPayFld("fpc-addiction",Math.abs(mods.addiction));setPayFld("fpc-inactive",Math.abs(mods.inactive));
    setPayTxt("fpc-s-emp",brGetName(li)||"-");setPayTxt("fpc-s-role",roleName||"-");
    setPayTxt("fpc-s-eff",eff||(mods.effectiveness?String(mods.effectiveness):"-"));setPayTxt("fpc-s-pay",pay||"-");
    setPayHtml("fpc-tags",mods.tags.map(t=>{const bad=/addiction|inactivity|-\d+/i.test(t),good=/working stats|settled|merits|director/i.test(t);return`<span class="fpc-pill ${bad?"bad":good?"good":""}">${escHtml(t)}</span>`;}).join(""));
    brRenderReqFit(req,stats,roleName,company);
    recalcPay();
}
function brResolveEmployeeRow(target){
    if(!target)return null;
    let current=target.nodeType===1
        ? target
        : target.parentElement;
    let best=null;
    let bestScore=-1;
    for(let depth=0;current&&depth<14;depth++,current=current.parentElement){
        if(current===document.body||current===document.documentElement)break;
        let score=0;
        if(current.matches?.(
            "li[data-user],li[data-user-id],li.employee,[class*='employeeRow'],[class*='employee-row']"
        ))score+=8;
        if(current.querySelector?.(
            'a[href*="profiles.php?XID="],a[href*="/profiles.php?XID="]'
        ))score+=5;
        if(current.querySelector?.(
            ".stats,[class*='workingStats'],[class*='workStats']"
        ))score+=4;
        if(current.querySelector?.(
            ".effectiveness,[class*='effectiveness']"
        ))score+=3;
        if(current.querySelector?.(
            'input[aria-label*="Pay" i],input[aria-label*="Wage" i],input[name*="pay"],input[name*="wage"],input[class*="pay"],input[class*="wage"]'
        ))score+=5;
        if(score>bestScore){
            best=current;
            bestScore=score;
        }
        if(score>=13)break;
    }
    return bestScore>=5
        ? best
        : brGetContainer(target);
}
function isPayTrigger(t){
    return !!t?.closest?.([
        ".pay",
        ".wage",
        ".salary",
        '[class*="pay"]',
        '[class*="wage"]',
        '[class*="salary"]',
        'input[name*="pay"]',
        'input[class*="pay"]',
        "input.employee-input-pay",
        'input[aria-label*="Pay" i]',
        'input[aria-label*="Wage" i]',
        'button[aria-label*="Pay" i]'
    ].join(","));
}
function onPayClick(e){
    if(
        !featureOn("employeeTools") ||
        !isEmployeesView() ||
        !isPayTrigger(e.target)
    )return;
    const row=brResolveEmployeeRow(e.target);
    if(!row)return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    openPayCalc(row).catch(error=>
        console.error("FC Pay Calculator error:",error)
    );
}

    function restorePosition(panel) {
      try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(
          localStorage.getItem(POSITION_KEY)
        );
        if (!saved) throw new Error();
        panel.style.left =
          `${Math.round(saved.xPct * window.innerWidth)}px`;
        panel.style.top =
          `${Math.round(saved.yPct * window.innerHeight)}px`;
        panel.style.right = "auto";
      } catch {
        panel.style.top = "54px";
        panel.style.right = "12px";
        panel.style.left = "auto";
      }
    }
    function makeDraggable(panel) {
      const header = panel.querySelector(".tma-header");
      if (!header) return;
      let dragging = false;
      let startX = 0;
      let startY = 0;
      let initialLeft = 0;
      let initialTop = 0;
      const move = event => {
        if (!dragging) return;
        const point = event.touches?.[0] || event;
        const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
        const left = Math.min(
          window.innerWidth - rect.width,
          Math.max(
            0,
            initialLeft + point.clientX - startX
          )
        );
        const top = Math.min(
          window.innerHeight - rect.height,
          Math.max(
            0,
            initialTop + point.clientY - startY
          )
        );
        panel.style.left = `${left}px`;
        panel.style.top = `${top}px`;
        panel.style.right = "auto";
      };
      const end = () => {
        if (!dragging) return;
        dragging = false;
        const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
        localStorage.setItem(
          POSITION_KEY,
          JSON.stringify({
            xPct: rect.left / window.innerWidth,
            yPct: rect.top / window.innerHeight
          })
        );
        document.removeEventListener("mousemove", move);
        document.removeEventListener("mouseup", end);
        document.removeEventListener("touchmove", move);
        document.removeEventListener("touchend", end);
      };
      const start = event => {
        if (event.target.closest("button")) return;
        const point = event.touches?.[0] || event;
        const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
        dragging = true;
        startX = point.clientX;
        startY = point.clientY;
        initialLeft = rect.left;
        initialTop = rect.top;
        document.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
        document.addEventListener("mouseup", end);
        document.addEventListener("touchmove", move, {
          passive: true
        });
        document.addEventListener("touchend", end);
      };
      header.addEventListener("mousedown", start);
      header.addEventListener("touchstart", start, {
        passive: true
      });
      moduleState.cleanup.push(() => {
        header.removeEventListener("mousedown", start);
        header.removeEventListener("touchstart", start);
        document.removeEventListener("mousemove", move);
        document.removeEventListener("mouseup", end);
        document.removeEventListener("touchmove", move);
        document.removeEventListener("touchend", end);
      });
      restorePosition(panel);
    }

  function readScans() {
    const d = loadLS(LS_SCANS_KEY);
    return { scans: (Array.isArray(d?.scans) ? d.scans : []).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2) };
  }
  function writeScan(scan) {
    const { scans } = readScans();
    const sameIdx = scans.findIndex(s => s?.stage === scan.stage);
    if (sameIdx >= 0) scans[sameIdx] = scan;
    else if (scans.length < 2) scans.push(scan);
    else {
      const oldestIdx = (scans[1]?.ts ?? 0) < (scans[0]?.ts ?? 0) ? 1 : 0;
      scans[oldestIdx] = scan;
    }
    saveLS(LS_SCANS_KEY, { scans });
    return scans;
  }
  function mergedScans() {
    const { scans } = readScans();
    const usersInOC = new Set();
    const reqByUser = {};
    const missingByUser = {};
    const roleByUser = {};
    const crimeByUser = {};
    for (const s of scans) {
      for (const xid of (s?.usersInOC ?? [])) usersInOC.add(String(xid));
      for (const [xid, arr] of Object.entries(s?.reqByUser ?? {})) {
        if (!reqByUser[xid]) reqByUser[xid] = [];
        const set = new Set(reqByUser[xid].map(String));
        for (const id of (arr ?? [])) if (isAllowedItemId(id)) set.add(String(id));
        reqByUser[xid] = [...set];
      }
      for (const [xid, arr] of Object.entries(s?.missingByUser ?? {})) {
        if (!missingByUser[xid]) missingByUser[xid] = [];
        const set = new Set(missingByUser[xid].map(String));
        for (const id of (arr ?? [])) if (isAllowedItemId(id)) set.add(String(id));
        missingByUser[xid] = [...set];
      }
      for (const [xid, role] of Object.entries(s?.roleByUser ?? {})) {
        if (role) roleByUser[xid] = String(role);
      }
      for (const [xid, crime] of Object.entries(s?.crimeByUser ?? {})) {
        if (crime) crimeByUser[xid] = String(crime);
      }
    }
    return {
      usersInOC: [...usersInOC],
      reqByUser,
      missingByUser,
      roleByUser,
      crimeByUser,
      scans
    };
  }
  function readNotInOC() {

  }

  function crimeTier(crime) {

  function crimeMemberIds(crime) {
    const output = new Set();
    const collections = [crime?.slots, crime?.participants, crime?.members, crime?.users, crime?.crew, crime?.crime?.slots];
    const collect = value => {
      if (!value) return;
      if (Array.isArray(value)) { value.forEach(collect); return; }
      if (typeof value !== "object") return;
      const direct = value.user_id ?? value.userId ?? value.member_id ?? value.memberId ?? value.xid ?? value.id;
      if (direct && /^\d+$/.test(String(direct))) output.add(String(direct));
      if (value.user) collect(value.user);
      if (value.member) collect(value.member);
      for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) {
        if (/^\d+$/.test(key) && child && typeof child === "object") output.add(String(key));
        if (child && typeof child === "object" && !["user", "member"].includes(key)) collect(child);
      }
    };
    collections.forEach(collect);
    return [...output];
  }

    const values = [crime?.executed_at, crime?.completed_at, crime?.finished_at, crime?.ended_at, crime?.resolution?.completed_at, crime?.timestamps?.completed, crime?.timestamps?.executed, crime?.ready_at].map(normalizeUnix).filter(Boolean);

  function crimeMemberIds(crime) {
    const output = new Set();
    const collections = [crime?.slots, crime?.participants, crime?.members, crime?.users, crime?.crew, crime?.crime?.slots];
    const collect = value => {
      if (!value) return;
      if (Array.isArray(value)) { value.forEach(collect); return; }
      if (typeof value !== "object") return;
      const direct = value.user_id ?? value.userId ?? value.member_id ?? value.memberId ?? value.xid ?? value.id;
      if (direct && /^\d+$/.test(String(direct))) output.add(String(direct));
      if (value.user) collect(value.user);
      if (value.member) collect(value.member);
      for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) {
        if (/^\d+$/.test(key) && child && typeof child === "object") output.add(String(key));
        if (child && typeof child === "object" && !["user", "member"].includes(key)) collect(child);
      }
    };
    collections.forEach(collect);
    return [...output];
  }
  function unwrapCrimeList(payload) {
    const candidates = [payload?.crimes, payload?.organized_crimes, payload?.organizedCrimes, payload?.data?.crimes, payload?.data?.organized_crimes, payload?.data];
    for (const value of candidates) {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
      if (value && typeof value === "object") {
        const arr = Object.values(value).filter(v => v && typeof v === "object");
        if (arr.length) return arr;
      }
    }
    return [];
  }
  async function tornApiFetch(path, apiKey) {
    const response = await fetch(`https://api.torn.com/v2${path}`, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: { "Authorization": `ApiKey ${apiKey}`, "Accept": "application/json" },
      credentials: "omit",
      cache: "no-store"
    });
    let data;
    try { data = await response.json(); }
    catch { throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`); }
    const apiError = data?.error || data?.errors?.[0];
    if (!response.ok || apiError) throw new Error(String(apiError?.error || apiError?.message || data?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`));
    return data;
  }

  function bindOcIntelSorting(panel) {
    const body = panel.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-intel-panel-body");
    if (!body) return;
    panel.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-sort-btn").forEach(btn => {
      if (btn.dataset.sakaluxSortBound === "1") return;
      btn.dataset.sakaluxSortBound = "1";
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const key = btn.dataset.sort;
        const currentKey = panel.dataset.sortKey;
        const currentDir = panel.dataset.sortDir || "desc";
        const nextDir = currentKey === key && currentDir === "desc" ? "asc" : "desc";
        panel.dataset.sortKey = key;
        panel.dataset.sortDir = nextDir;
        panel.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-sort-btn").forEach(b => {
          b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn);
          b.dataset.dir = b === btn ? nextDir : "";
        });
        const rows = Array.from(body.querySelectorAll(".sakalux-oco-intel-panel-row"));
        rows.sort((a, b) => {
          if (key === "name") {
            const av = a.dataset.name || "";
            const bv = b.dataset.name || "";
            return nextDir === "asc" ? av.localeCompare(bv) : bv.localeCompare(av);
          }
          const av = Number(a.dataset[key] || 0);
          const bv = Number(b.dataset[key] || 0);
          return nextDir === "asc" ? av - bv : bv - av;
        });
        rows.forEach(row => body.appendChild(row));
      });
    });
  }

  function showOcIntelTooltip(target) {

    const tr = tip.getBoundingClientRect();

    let top = r.top - tr.height - 8;
    left = Math.max(8, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - tr.width - 8));
    if (top < 8) top = r.bottom + 8;
    tip.style.left = `${left}px`;
    tip.style.top = `${top}px`;
  }

    function updateFlagIcon(container, userId) {
        const trigger = container.querySelector('.sakalux-flag-trigger');
        if (!trigger) return;
        const data = getCountryDataForUser(userId);
        const nextCode = data?.code || "";
        const nextName = data?.name || "";
        container.title = data
            ? `${data.name} - click to change`
            : "Click to choose a country";
        trigger.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            data ? `Country: ${data.name}` : "Click to choose a country"
        );
        if (
            container.dataset.countryCode === nextCode &&
            container.dataset.countryName === nextName &&
            trigger.firstElementChild
        ) {
            return;
        }
        container.dataset.countryCode = nextCode;
        container.dataset.countryName = nextName;
        trigger.innerHTML = data?.code
            ? `<img src="${getFlagImageUrl(data.code)}" alt="${escapeHtml(data.name)}" class="sakalux-country-flag-img">`
            : `<span class="sakalux-country-flag-placeholder">+</span>`;
    }
    function createFlagIcon(userId, memberName, tagName = 'div') {
        const el = document.createElement(tagName);
        el.className = `${FLAG_CLASS} sakalux-country-days-slot`;
        el.dataset.userId = userId;
        el.dataset.userName = memberName;
        const trigger = document.createElement('span');
        trigger.className = 'sakalux-flag-trigger';
        trigger.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        trigger.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        const openHandler = (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            openCountryPicker(el, userId, memberName, trigger);
        };
        el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => e.stopPropagation());
        el.addEventListener('click', openHandler);
        el.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            openHandler(e);
        }, { passive: false });
        trigger.addEventListener('mousedown', e => e.stopPropagation());
        trigger.addEventListener('click', openHandler);
        trigger.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            openHandler(e);
        }, { passive: false });
        trigger.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') openHandler(e);
        });
        el.appendChild(trigger);
        updateFlagIcon(el, userId);
        return el;
    }
    function getCandidateCells(row) {
        let cells = Array.from(row.children || []).filter(el => {
            const tag = el.tagName?.toLowerCase();
            return tag === 'li' || tag === 'td' || tag === 'div';
        });
        if (cells.length < 4) {
            cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('li, td, .table-cell, [class*="cell"]'));
        }
        return cells;
    }
    function looksLikeDaysValue(text) {
        const t = String(text || '').trim();
        if (!/^\d{1,5}$/.test(t)) return false;
        const n = Number(t);
        return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n <= 10000;
    }
    function findDaysCell(record) {
        const row = record.row;
        if (!row) return null;
        const directDays = row.querySelector(
            '.table-cell.days, li.table-cell.days, div.table-cell.days'
        );
        if (directDays) {
            const stored =
                directDays.dataset.sakaluxOriginalDays ||
                directDays.querySelector(
                    ".sakalux-country-days-number"
                )?.textContent ||
                directDays.textContent ||
                "";
            if (looksLikeDaysValue(String(stored).trim())) {
                return directDays;
            }
        }
        const cells = getCandidateCells(row);
        if (!cells.length) return null;
        const statusIndex = cells.findIndex(cell => {
            const text = (cell.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            return (
                text.includes('okay') ||
                text.includes('trav') ||
                text.includes('hos') ||
                text.includes('jail') ||
                text.includes('federal') ||
                text.includes('abroad')
            );
        });
        if (statusIndex > 0) {
            for (let i = statusIndex - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const cell = cells[i];
                const original = cell.dataset.sakaluxOriginalDays || cell.textContent || '';
                if (looksLikeDaysValue(original)) return cell;
            }
        }
        for (const cell of cells) {
            const original = cell.dataset.sakaluxOriginalDays || cell.textContent || '';
            if (looksLikeDaysValue(original)) return cell;
        }
        return null;
    }
    function updateCountryDaysHeaders() {
        const possibleHeaders = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('li, th, td, div, span'));
        possibleHeaders.forEach(header => {
            if (header.dataset.sakaluxCountryDaysHeader === '1') return;
            const text = (header.textContent || '').trim();
            if (text !== 'Days') return;
            const parentText = (header.parentElement?.textContent || '').toLowerCase();
            const likelyFactionHeader =
                parentText.includes('lvl') &&
                parentText.includes('ff') &&
                parentText.includes('status');
            if (!likelyFactionHeader) return;
            header.dataset.sakaluxCountryDaysHeader = '1';
            header.innerHTML = `
                <div class="sakalux-country-days-header">
                    <span class="sakalux-country-title">Country</span>
                    <span class="sakalux-days-title">Days</span>
                </div>
            `;
        });
    }

    function findNativeHeaderCell(label) {

        if (!list) return null;

        return Array.from(
            list.querySelectorAll("li.table-cell, .table-cell")
        ).find(cell => {
            const text = String(cell.childNodes?.[0]?.textContent || cell.textContent || "")
                .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
                .trim();
            return text === label || text.startsWith(`${label} `);
        }) || null;
    }

    function readStatusRows() {
        const cells = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div.table-cell.status, .table-cell.status'));
        const records = [];

    function statusRow(statusCell) {
        let el = statusCell;
        for (let i = 0; i < 18 && el && el !== document.body; i++) {
            const cells = rowCells(el);
            if (cells.length >= 5 && cells.some(c => c === statusCell || c.contains(statusCell))) {
                return el;
            }
            el = el.parentElement;
        }

    }
    function rowCells(row) {
        return Array.from(row.children || []).filter(el => {
            const tag = (el.tagName || '').toLowerCase();
            return tag === 'li' || tag === 'td' || tag === 'div';
        });
    }
    function daysCellFor(row, statusCell) {
        const cells = rowCells(row);
        const statusIndex = cells.findIndex(c => c === statusCell || c.contains(statusCell));
        if (statusIndex > 0) {
            for (let i = statusIndex - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const days = readDaysCell(cells[i]);
                if (days !== null) return cells[i];
            }
        }
        const stored = row.querySelector('[data-sakalux-original-days]');
        if (stored && readDaysCell(stored) !== null) return stored;
        return null;
    }
    function readDays(record) {
        if (!record.daysCell) return null;
        return readDaysCell(record.daysCell);
    }
    function readDaysCell(cell) {
        if (!cell) return null;
        const original = cell.dataset?.sakaluxOriginalDays;
        if (isDaysNumber(original)) return Number(original);
        const daysNumber = cell.querySelector?.('.sakalux-country-days-number');
        if (daysNumber && isDaysNumber(daysNumber.textContent)) {
            return Number(String(daysNumber.textContent).trim());
        }
        const text = getCleanText(cell);
        if (isDaysNumber(text)) return Number(text);
        const matches = text.match(/\b\d{1,5}\b/g);
        if (!matches) return null;
        const nums = matches
            .map(Number)
            .filter(n => Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n <= 10000);
        if (!nums.length) return null;
        return nums[nums.length - 1];
    }
    function isDaysNumber(value) {
        const text = String(value || '').trim();
        if (!/^\d{1,5}$/.test(text)) return false;
        const num = Number(text);
        return Number.isFinite(num) && num >= 0 && num <= 10000;
    }

  function stopDashboard() {

      }

    function parseMoney(str) {
        if (!str) return 0;

    }

    function parseSignedMoneyValue(str) {
        if (!str) return 0;
        let s = String(str).trim();
        const negative = /^\s*-/.test(s) || /-\s*\$/.test(s);
        s = s.replace(/[$,\s+]/g, "").replace(/[^0-9.\-BMK]/gi, "").replace(/^-/, "");
        const mult = /B$/i.test(s) ? 1_000_000_000 : /M$/i.test(s) ? 1_000_000 : /K$/i.test(s) ? 1_000 : 1;
        const val = parseFloat(s.replace(/[BMK]/ig, "")) || 0;
        return (negative ? -1 : 1) * val * mult;
    }

    function calcStdDev(values) {
        const nums = values.map(Number).filter(v => !isNaN(v));
        if (nums.length <= 1) return 0;
        const avg = nums.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / nums.length;
        const variance = nums.reduce((sum, v) => sum + Math.pow(v - avg, 2), 0) / nums.length;
        return Math.sqrt(variance);
    }
    function consistencyGrade(avg, stdDev, partPct = 100, zeroRate = 0, recentNoHit = 0, currentHitStreak = 0) {
        const participation = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(partPct) || 0));
        const zeros = Math.max(0, Number(zeroRate) || 0);
        const recentZeros = Math.max(0, Number(recentNoHit) || 0);
        const streak = Math.max(0, Number(currentHitStreak) || 0);
        const avgHits = Number(avg) || 0;
        const dev = Number(stdDev) || 0;
        const cv = avgHits ? dev / avgHits : 0;
        let score = 100;
        score -= Math.max(0, 100 - participation) * 0.45;
        score -= zeros * 0.30;
        score -= recentZeros * 8;
        if (streak >= 10) score += 5;
        if (avgHits > 0 && cv > 1.2) score -= 6;
        score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(score)));
        if (score >= 94) return "A+";
        if (score >= 84) return "A";
        if (score >= 72) return "B";
        if (score >= 56) return "C";
        return "D";
    }
    function consistencyHint(grade) {
        return ({
            "A+": "Elite",
            "A": "Stable",
            "B": "Good",
            "C": "Variable",
            "D": "Erratic",
            "-": "Not enough data"
        })[grade] || "Not enough data";
    }

        document.body.appendChild(pop);
        let _activeBadge=null;
        const closePopup=()=>{pop.classList.remove("fc-vis");_activeBadge=null;};
        const positionPopup=(badge)=>{const r=badge.getBoundingClientRect(),pw=260,ph=148,pad=8;let left=r.left,top=r.bottom+6;if(left+pw>window.innerWidth-pad)left=window.innerWidth-pw-pad;if(top+ph>window.innerHeight-pad)top=r.top-ph-6;pop.style.left=`${Math.max(pad,left)}px`;pop.style.top=`${Math.max(pad,top)}px`;};
        document.getElementById("fc-bp-pop-close").addEventListener("click",closePopup);
        document.getElementById("fc-bp-pop-save").addEventListener("click",()=>{if(!_activeBadge)return;const v=Math.max(0,Math.round(parseFloat(document.getElementById("fc-bp-pop-inp").value)||0));const role=_activeBadge.dataset.role;bpSet(role,v);_activeBadge.textContent=v>0?`$${v.toLocaleString()}`:"$";_activeBadge.classList.toggle("is-set",v>0);closePopup();});
        document.getElementById("fc-bp-pop-clear").addEventListener("click",()=>{if(!_activeBadge)return;bpSet(_activeBadge.dataset.role,0);_activeBadge.textContent="$";_activeBadge.classList.remove("is-set");closePopup();});
        document.getElementById("fc-bp-pop-inp").addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter")document.getElementById("fc-bp-pop-save").click();if(e.key==="Escape")closePopup();});
        document.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{if(!pop.classList.contains("fc-vis"))return;if(pop.contains(e.target)||e.target.classList.contains("fc-bp-badge"))return;closePopup();},true);
        pop._open=(badge)=>{_activeBadge=badge;const role=badge.dataset.role;const stored=bpGet(role);document.getElementById("fc-bp-pop-role").textContent=role;document.getElementById("fc-bp-pop-inp").value=stored||"";positionPopup(badge);pop.classList.add("fc-vis");setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById("fc-bp-pop-inp").focus(),40);};
    }
    const popup=document.getElementById("fc-bp-popup");
    cpGetPositionRows().forEach(row=>{
        if(row.dataset.fcBpDone==="1")return;
        const roleName=cpGetRoleName(row);if(!roleName)return;
        row.dataset.fcBpDone="1";

        const stored=bpGet(roleName);

        nameEl.appendChild(badge);
    });

function getStockWrapper() {
    return document.querySelector([
        ".stock-list-wrap",
        '[class*="stockListWrap"]',
        '[class*="stock-list"]',
        '[class*="warehouse"]'
    ].join(","));
}
function getStockRows() {
    const w=getStockWrapper();
    if(!w)return[];
    return Array.from(w.querySelectorAll([
        "ul.stock-list.fm-list > li",
        "ul.stock-list > li",
        '[class*="stockList"] > li',
        '[class*="stock-list"] > li'
    ].join(","))).filter(row=>
        !row.classList.contains("total") &&
        !!row.querySelector('input,.quantity,[class*="quantity"]')
    );
}
function getStorageCapacity() { const maxEl=document.querySelector(".storage-capacity .max"),curEl=document.querySelector(".storage-capacity .current");if(!maxEl||!curEl)return null;const maxCapacity=cleanNum(maxEl.textContent),currentUsed=cleanNum(curEl.getAttribute("data-initial")||curEl.textContent);return{maxCapacity,currentUsed,availableSpace:maxCapacity-currentUsed}; }

function flashFcBtn(btn,text,variant,revertText,delay=1300) { setFcBtnState(btn,text,variant);setTimeout(()=>setFcBtnState(btn,revertText||text,"navy"),delay); }

    else{mobileLabel.innerText="Days Left: ";mobileLabel.style.marginRight="5px";Array.from(delivCell.childNodes).forEach(n=>{if(n.nodeType===3&&n.textContent.trim())n.remove();});if(!delivCell.contains(badge))delivCell.appendChild(badge);}
    const baseStock=parseFloat(row.dataset.fcStock||"0")||0,soldDaily=parseFloat(row.dataset.fcDaily||"0")||0,added=cleanNum(input?input.value:"0"),total=baseStock+added,days=soldDaily>0?total/soldDaily:(total>0?999:0);

    if(e)e.preventDefault();
    const btn=document.getElementById("fc-get-stocked-btn");
    const storage=getStorageCapacity();
    if(!storage){flashFcBtn(btn,"No Capacity","red","Stock Up",1400);alert("Could not read Storage Capacity.");return;}
    if(storage.availableSpace<=0){flashFcBtn(btn,"Warehouse Full","red","Stock Up",1400);return;}
    const items=getStockRows().map(r=>({row:r,input:r.querySelector(".quantity input"),stock:parseFloat(r.dataset.fcStock||0)||0,daily:parseFloat(r.dataset.fcDaily||0)||0})).filter(it=>it.input&&it.daily>0);
    if(!items.length){flashFcBtn(btn,"No Items","red","Stock Up",1300);return;}
    let lo=0,hi=CFG.maxSimDays,optDays=0;
    for(let i=0;i<25;i++){const mid=(lo+hi)/2;const needed=items.reduce((s,it)=>s+Math.max(0,(it.daily*mid)-it.stock),0);if(needed<=storage.availableSpace){optDays=mid;lo=mid;}else hi=mid;}

    flashFcBtn(btn,"Stock Up","green","Stock Up",1200);
